jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - AI
jobs.description:
Job Description
Role Overview

As a DevOps Engineer - AI Platform & MLOps, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and operational excellence practices that support AI and machine learning solutions. You will work closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Solution Architects, and Platform Engineers to ensure AI services are secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready.

Key Responsibilities

AI Platform Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain cloud-native infrastructure supporting AI workloads.
• Manage AI platform environments across development, test, UAT, and production.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and Bicep.
• Optimize infrastructure performance, costs, resilience, and availability.

MLOps & Deployment Automation

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI and machine learning solutions.
• Automate model deployment, validation, testing, and rollback processes.
• Support model lifecycle management, versioning, monitoring, and governance.
• Enable automated retraining and deployment workflows where required.

Cloud & Security

• Implement security best practices across AI environments.
• Manage identities, secrets, certificates, and access controls.
• Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.
• Conduct vulnerability remediation and platform hardening activities.

Platform Reliability & Operations

• Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability frameworks.
• Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root-cause analysis.
• Define and monitor platform SLAs, SLOs, and operational metrics.
• Drive continuous improvement of platform stability and performance.

Collaboration & Engineering Excellence

• Partner with AI Engineers and Solution Architects to operationalize AI solutions.
• Support production releases and deployment readiness reviews.
• Contribute to platform standards, reusable templates, and automation frameworks.
• Mentor development teams on DevOps and AI operational best practices.

AI / MLOps Experience

Experience in one or more of the following:

• Azure AI Foundry
• Azure OpenAI Service
• Machine Learning Operations (MLOps)
• Model deployment and monitoring
• Vector databases and retrieval systems
• LLM application deployment and operations
• AI governance and operational monitoring

Security & Governance

• Identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID.
• Secrets management using Azure Key Vault.
• Security scanning and vulnerability management.
• Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through:

• Reliability and availability of AI platforms.
• Deployment frequency and release quality.
• Infrastructure automation coverage.
• Security and compliance adherence.
• Reduction of operational incidents and recovery times.
• Continuous improvement of AI delivery efficiency.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to build enterprise-scale AI solutions.
• Exposure to the latest Generative AI technologies.
• Collaborative and innovation-driven engineering culture.
• Career growth within a global technology organization.
• The chance to help shape the future of AI-powered enterprise software.

Qualifications
Required Skills & Experience

• 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related technical field. Masters will be an added advantage
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
• Strong experience with:

• Azure DevOps
• Bitbucket
• Terraform and/or Bicep
• Docker
• Kubernetes (AKS preferred)
• CI/CD pipeline implementation

• Experience with monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, or Prometheus.
• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Digital Advanced Automations Solutions
jobs.summary: We are looking for a Senior Specialist, Digital Advanced Automations Solutions to drive impactful AI and analytics initiatives, developing and implementing advanced solutions to automate business processes. The role involves leading technical projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and requires significant experience in AI and machine learning within a technical and managerial capacity.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Generate insights by leveraging the latest Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Analytics techniques to derive value at the overall organization level. Building world-class solutions, conquer business problems, address technical challenges using AI Platforms and technologies.

Utilize the existing frameworks, standards, patterns to create architectural foundation and services necessary for AI applications that scale from multi-user to enterprise-class. Developing and implementing Advanced solutions to support the business stakeholders to have automated business processes and to take informed decisions

Identify and analyse trends and patterns in Artificial Intelligence tools to be used for diagnosis and prediction purpose. Research on existing AI solutions to fit into business requirements and contribute to formulating prototypes for innovative ideas, filing patents and research papers

Develop and manage Advanced Solutions, applications integrations, and machine learning to meet business requirements.

Provides technical expertise and recommendations in assessing new Digital software projects and initiatives to support and enhance existing systems.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

· Work on functional design, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), prototyping, testing, training, and defining support procedures, working with an advanced engineering team and executive leadership.

· Manage solutions development and implementations going through the full Solutions Development Life Cycle phases.

· Supervise necessary applications amendments and responsible for reviewing, analysing, and modifying systems including encoding, testing, debugging, and installing to support application systems.

· Aid and advice to business users in the effective use of applications and information technology.

· Identify opportunities that can improve efficiency of business processes.

· Filter Data by reviewing reports and performance indicators to identify and correct code problems

· Use statistical tools to identify, analyse, and interpret patterns and trends in complex data sets that could be helpful for the diagnosis and prediction

· Collaborate with programmers, engineers, and management heads to identify process improvement opportunities, propose system modifications, and devise data governance strategies.

· Supervise and support the team to ensure smooth operation of systems and handles/trouble shoots complicated problems raised by users upon escalation by the Digital Help Desk Team or other members of the Solutions team.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyse the partner’s business and main areas where the application of AI can stimulate business growth.

· Prepare final analysis reports for the stakeholders to understand the data-analysis steps, enabling them to take important decisions based on various facts and trends.

· Document and articulate solution architecture and lessons learned for each exploration and accelerated incubation

· Analyse local, national, and global trends and predictions that impact both the organization and the industry and report to management.

IT Strategic & Tactical Planning

· Coordinate and consult with the business and Digital management to ensure that the Group Digital Advanced Automations solutions strategy components are successfully translated into solutions and services.

· Contribute to the regular review of the Group Digital Strategy at pre-defined intervals to ensure that it reflects the concerned Directorates business requirements and ensures its constant alignment with the Company's short, medium, and long-term business plans.

· Whenever applicable, ensures that the Group Digital Unit strategic goals, strategies and roadmaps are translated into sectional tactical plans and actionable items, in full coordination with other Digital departments and sections.

Group Digital Advanced Automations Solutions Delivery

· Conduct the analysis, scope development, technical evaluations, and prototyping, developing, implementing, and delivering Solutions Delivery Capture business requirements related to the domain.

· Ensure the delivery of the vertical’s business requirements and services according to the Company standard and strategies.

· Support the vertical’s business users and beyond in line with pre-set SLAs and delivery guidelines.

· Lead the development, implementation, and support of high quality and cost-effective Solutions and services deemed critical to the business operations.

· Ensure that the department meets the appropriate service level agreements established with internal and group users’ functions. Also, that the services delivered by the engaged external organizations are delivered within the agreed service levels.

· Ensure that all deployed solutions have followed a comprehensive testing and quality assurance process, quality assurance reviews and have fulfilled the Group Digital Unit services release process requirements.

· Ensure that the enterprise architecture principals, data management and information security standards are applied throughout the solution development and implementation lifecycles.

· Report to the management on the progress of assigned programs and projects against plans, in terms of schedule, resources and cost.

· Ensure that all programs and projects are managed in compliance with the Projects Management Methodology and related standards.

Conduct pre-deployment activities of Advanced Automations Solutions

· Lead feasibility studies, assess business requirements, and assist in designing business processes for small to large systems and implementations. Submit findings and recommendations for review, evaluation, and approval by Digital and Business management. Participate in feasibility studies of Digital Programs undertaken within the unit wherever required.

· Analyse functional requirements including input transactions, output reports, functional processes, etc. and recommends solutions and process improvements for user approval to establish functional specifications.

· Perform impact analysis for new development to ensure synchronization and integration of cross functional business solutions and systems.

· Lead the development of business cases and projects initiation documentations and artifacts.

Evaluate new solutions and services

· Evaluate off-the-shelf packages to ascertain the degree of fitness with existing business processes and recommends appropriate solutions to business requirements.

· Wherever required, develop the required interfaces between various solutions while ensuring systems and data availability, integrity, and service continuity.

· Develop fit-for-purpose and secure software programs. Test them to ensure their fulfilment of business requirements and their compliance with ADNOC Group Digital standards and policies.

· Receive, assess, and prioritize change requests from the existing Digital services owners and users.

Document Group Digital Advanced Automations Solutions

· In coordination with the enterprise and technology architects; prepare solutions design documents, data models, data flow diagrams and other system architecture artifacts.

· Update the solutions documentation throughout the company systems development & support lifecycles in accordance with the Company standards on the subject.

· Archive and keep available all as-build solutions documents and artifacts.

Act as an SME for the future domain specific implementations

· Implement the best practices for all Group Digital Advanced Automations solutions, and services implementations

· Plan and undertake the deployment of the required new software releases.

· Provide the required training and support to users during and after deployment.

Supervision

· Plan, supervise and coordinate all domain activities in the assigned area to meet functional objectives.

· Train and develop the assigned staff on relevant skills to enable them to become proficient on the job and deliver the respective business objectives.

Budgets

· Provide input for preparation of the Function / Division / Department / Section budgets, assist in the implementation of the approved Budget, and work plans to deliver business objectives.

· Investigate and highlight any significant variances to support effective performance and cost control.

Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures

· Implement approved Function/ Division/ Department/ Section policies, processes, systems, standards and procedures in order to support execution of the work programs in line with Company and International standards.

Performance Management

· Contribute to the achievement of the approved Performance Objectives for the Function/ Division / Department/ Section in line with the Company Performance framework.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

· Design and implement new tools and techniques to improve the quality and efficiency of operational processes.

· Identify improvements in internal processes against best practices in pursuit of greater efficiency in line with best industry standards to define intelligent solutions for issues confronting the function.

Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability

· Comply with relevant HSE policies, procedures, controls, applicable legislation, and sustainability guidelines in line with international standards, best practices and ADNOC Code of Practices.

Reports

· Provide inputs to prepare MIS and progress reports for Company Management.

COMMUNICATIONS & WORKING RELATIONSHIPS:

Internal

· Regular contacts with Digital Management Team across ADNOC Group on services delivery, services operations, services governance, and other related matters.

· Frequent contacts with Programs / Projects Managers and Architects on matters related to roadmaps developments and projects and programs delivery.

· Regular contacts with the counterparts in ADNOC Group Companies on Digital Strategy, Planning and Quality Assurance matters.

External

· Frequent contacts with external auditors, local / international vendors, consultants, and Digital professional organizations to facilitate quality and cost-effective service delivery.

· Occasional contacts with counterparts in regional and international oil companies for exchange of information / benchmarking / study visits and other programs.

· Regular contacts with local and international Digital service providers on matters related to Digital services and strategic directions.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

· Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

· 10 years of relevant IT experience including at least 6 years in positions of progressively increasing technical and managerial responsibilities in AI and Machine Learning Solutions

· Deep Knowledge of Machine learning, deep learning, NLP, Python, NoSQL, RDBMS,

· Experience in application development, preferably in an oil industry environment.

Professional Certifications

· Certification in Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence (Desired)

· Certification in PMP (Desired)

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES:

· As per the approved competency dictionary

BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES:

· As per the approved competency dictionary

jobs.title: Graduate Trainee - Technology (UAE Nationals)
jobs.summary: We are recruiting a Graduate Trainee - Technology to support the ADNOC Group’s technology initiatives. This role offers hands-on experience and training for UAE Nationals, focusing on developing technical skills and gaining exposure to the organisation’s culture. Ideal for recent graduates in technology-related fields seeking to build a career within the UAE energy sector.
jobs.description:
Technology Graduates

The ADNOC Group recognizes the importance of having a skilled and engaged workforce in order to maintain and improve the levels of service that ADNOC Group provides globally. In order to achieve its progressive agenda, ADNOC Group provides rigorous training and development at all levels within the organisation especially for UAE National Fresh Graduates.

The ADNOC Fresh Graduate Program is a key initiative focused on developing the knowledge of its Trainees who may then become a permanent part of the ADNOC Group at the end of the program.

Objectives

• To Provide Fresh Graduates with the opportunity to develop their skills and expertise while working for the ADNOC Group as Trainees;
• To select top-tier candidates for the ADNOC Group future talent pool through competency assessments and performance reviews during the Trainee’s program;
• To facilitate the transition from Trainee to Employee and to expose Trainees to the culture of the ADNOC Group before potentially being offered permanent employment as a direct hire employee;
• To provide valuable real-life work experience and on-the-job training within the ADNOC Group even for those that are not able to join permanently.

Majors Include:

• Computer, Software or Network Engineering
• Computer Science
• Database Management
• Information Technology
• Cyber Security
• Automation in Data Science
• Machine Learning
• Management Information Systems
• Web Development
• and other technology related disciplines

Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for consideration for the ADNOC Group Fresh Graduates Program, candidates are required to meet all of the following criteria in addition to any job specific criteria deemed necessary by ADNOC:

• This program is reserved for UAE Nationals;
• Medical fitness in accordance with the work environment of the role;
• Government clearances including certificate of good conduct from Ministry of Interior;
• Completion of all entry Assessments and interviews, including but not limited to, personality and ability assessments; and
• Successful completion of National Service, unless exempted by UAE law.

Please note that Trainees who successfully complete the program are not necessarily guaranteed a permanent contract with ADNOC Group.

If you meet the eligibility criteria and would like to register in the program, Click Apply.

What is next:

Recruitment Team will review all the applications against the job requirements & will update the applicants.

For more information about AGFGP, click here.

jobs.title: Security Consultant
locations: Abu Dhabi, Sowwah Square - Al Sila Tower
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Support the delivery of OT Cybersecurity engagements across consulting, engineering, architecture, design, and implementation. This role combines advisory expertise with hands-on technical delivery, partnering with clients, OT teams, OEMs, and technology vendors to design, implement, and maintain secure OT environments that align with business and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Support end-to-end OT Cybersecurity engagements spanning assessments, strategy, architecture, engineering, design, and implementation.
• Conduct OT cybersecurity maturity assessments, gap analyses, risk assessments, and security reviews across industrial and critical infrastructure environments.
• Design and engineer OT cybersecurity solutions aligned with client requirements, operational needs, and industry best practices.
• Develop detailed OT security architectures, network designs, technical specifications, security controls, and implementation roadmaps.
• Support the implementation and configuration of OT security technologies, including network segmentation, firewalls, secure remote access, asset visibility, monitoring, vulnerability management, and other cybersecurity controls.
• Participate in technical design workshops, solution engineering, system integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handover activities.
• Collaborate with OT, engineering, IT, and cybersecurity teams to translate business and operational requirements into secure, practical technical solutions.
• Work closely with OT OEMs, system integrators, and technology vendors to design, integrate, and validate cybersecurity solutions.
• Apply industry-leading OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks, including IEC 62443, NIST, NERC CIP, and ISO 27001/27019.
• Develop technical deliverables such as High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), security architectures, assessment reports, technical specifications, and implementation documentation.
• Support client workshops, technical presentations, demonstrations, and stakeholder engagement activities.
• Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution development initiatives, and the creation of new OT cybersecurity offerings.
• Stay current with emerging OT technologies, cybersecurity threats, regulatory requirements, and engineering best practices.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• 4-8 years of cybersecurity experience, including significant exposure to OT/ICS cybersecurity environments.
• Proven experience delivering OT cybersecurity consulting, engineering, design, and implementation engagements.
• Strong understanding of OT/ICS architectures, industrial networks, communication protocols, control systems, and engineering environments.
• Hands-on experience designing, implementing, or supporting OT security technologies and solutions.
• Experience working with OT OEMs, system integrators, and industrial technology vendors.
• Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, particularly IEC 62443 and NIST.
• Experience developing HLDs, LLDs, network and security architectures, technical designs, and implementation specifications.
• Experience supporting system integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handover activities is highly desirable.
• Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are advantageous.
• Experience within Energy, Oil & Gas, Utilities, Manufacturing, Mining, or other Critical Infrastructure sectors is preferred.
• Strong analytical, technical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Demonstrated ability to operate across both advisory and hands-on engineering environments, translating cybersecurity requirements into practical and implementable solutions.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

As a Business Process & AI Transformation Consultant, you will help organizations reimagine business processes through the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies. You will assess industry trends, identify transformation opportunities, and design future-state operating models that integrate AI at scale. Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will define practical, scalable transformation strategies that drive operational efficiency, innovation, and business value.

Key Responsibilities

• Assess industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technology developments to identify opportunities for AI-driven business transformation.
• Analyze current business processes and operating models to identify areas for optimization through AI and intelligent automation.
• Design future-state business processes that leverage AI, automation, and digital technologies to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
• Define AI integration points across business processes, systems, workflows, data sources, and decision-making activities.
• Develop detailed process transformation designs, including system interactions, data flows, automation requirements, and human-machine collaboration models.
• Recommend operating model changes that support sustainable AI adoption, including governance structures, roles, responsibilities, and performance measures.
• Facilitate alignment between business and technology stakeholders throughout transformation initiatives.
• Provide subject matter expertise on industry- and function-specific requirements, regulations, governance frameworks, and business practices.
• Support the development of transformation roadmaps, implementation strategies, and change management approaches.
• Communicate complex process, technology, and AI design decisions to senior leadership in a clear, business-focused manner.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure AI-enabled solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with organizational objectives.
• Promote best practices for AI adoption, process excellence, and continuous improvement across transformation programs.

Basic Qualifications

• 4-7 years of experience in Business Transformation, Process Consulting, Management Consulting, Digital Transformation, Intelligent Automation, or related fields.
• Experience analyzing and redesigning business processes to improve operational performance and business outcomes.
• Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and digital transformation principles.
• Experience developing target operating models, process frameworks, and transformation roadmaps.
• Strong understanding of business process design methodologies and process improvement techniques.
• Experience facilitating workshops and collaborating with business and technology stakeholders.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting AI, automation, or enterprise transformation initiatives across one or more business functions or industries.
• Familiarity with process mining, workflow automation, business architecture, and operating model design.
• Knowledge of AI governance, compliance, risk management, and responsible AI practices.
• Experience documenting future-state processes, data flows, and system integration requirements.
• Strong stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.
• Experience working with transformation tools, process modeling frameworks, and enterprise technology platforms.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


About POWERTECH

POWERTECH is a center of excellence for propulsion technologies, specializing in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of combustion engines, expendable turbojet engines, and turbofan engines for a wide range of aerospace, defence, and autonomous applications, including fixed- and rotary-wing UAVs and other advanced platforms.

Role Summary

Ensure products, processes, and services meet defined quality standards, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Analyze quality performance data, identify risks, investigate issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to drive quality excellence throughout the product or service lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES


- Quality Assurance & Compliance
Monitor compliance with internal quality management systems, policies, and procedures.
Ensure adherence to customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
Participate in internal, external, and customer audits.
Maintain quality documentation, records, and reports.

- Quality Control & Monitoring
Develop and implement quality control plans and inspection processes.
Monitor product and process quality performance using established metrics.
Review inspection and test results to ensure conformity to specifications.
Escalate quality concerns and support resolution activities.

- Non-Conformance Management
Investigate product, process, or service non-conformities.
Perform root cause analysis using quality tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.
Verify effectiveness of implemented corrective actions.

- Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities for process improvement and waste reduction.
Support Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or other quality improvement programs.
Drive initiatives to improve quality performance indicators.
Facilitate lessons learned and best-practice sharing across teams. - Data Analysis & Reporting
Collect, analyze, and interpret quality data and trends.
Develop quality dashboards and management reports.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as defect rates, customer complaints, and process capability.
Provide recommendations based on data-driven insights.

- Customer Quality Support
Address customer quality concerns and complaints.
Support investigations and corrective actions related to customer issues.
Participate in customer meetings and quality reviews where required.
Ensure customer expectations are understood and incorporated into quality processes.

- Supplier Quality Management
Support supplier qualification and performance evaluation activities.
Monitor supplier quality performance and manage supplier-related corrective actions.
Collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality issues.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Professional certification is desirable:
- Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)
- Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
- ISO 9001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor
- Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS).
- Knowledge of quality tools and methodologies.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and quality reporting tools.
- Familiarity with statistical analysis and problem-solving techniques.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


3 to 5 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, or Quality Control roles.
Experience working within a structured Quality Management System.
Experience conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
Experience in quality audits, inspections, and compliance activities.
Demonstrated ability to analyze data and drive quality improvements.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE
Cinema Service Engineer | MAF Entertainment | Cinemas

ROLE SUMMARY
The Cinema Service Engineer will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, repair, and support of digital cinema projection, audio, networking, and presentation systems across VOX Cinemas locations. The role involves troubleshooting technical issues, supporting new cinema deployments, monitoring system performance, coordinating installations, and ensuring optimal cinema presentation standards while maintaining safety, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and equipment delivery.
• Maintain technical documentation, installation reports, and calibration records.
• Provide technical support, fault diagnosis, and remote assistance for cinema systems and equipment.
• Ensure compliance with safety standards, security procedures, and company policies during all technical activities.

• Bachelor’s degree, Diploma, or Technical Certification in Electrical Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Digital Commercial & Financial Solutions

jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Senior Analyst (Group Commercial & Financial Solutions) deploys, customizes, maintains, and supports high quality, cost effective Commercial & Financial solutions to meet ADNOC Group digital business requirements.

Senior Analyst (Group Commercial & Financial Solutions) plans, coordinates and participates in development of domain specific strategies and plans and in the evaluations and reviews of business processes required for new solutions deployment, existing applications and services change management, applications security and controls, and the provision of enhancements of existing applications, solutions, and services.

The Senior Analyst (Group Commercial & Financial Solutions) leads and coordinates the development and support of required interfaces between existing and future systems. Participates in the evaluation of packages to match business requirements and undertakes configuration, testing, upgrade, and maintenance of the Company digital solutions and services.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Identification of Business Needs

· Partner with Group Commercial & Financial process owners to identify the technological needs and explore solutions to build and maintain a scalable and agile IT solutions meeting all current and future business requirements while ensuring alignment of all Trade & Financial related IT Business Solutions projects with approved ADNOC Group Digital & Cybersecurity standards, including the security standards and overall enterprise architecture framework.

· Plan and conduct feasibility studies, business cases, request for proposals and proof of concepts following Group Digital & Cybersecurity project management methodology for new IT solutions or services.

· Review third party proposals and technical documentation for digital Solutions to assure alignment to defined protocols and security governance standards. Provide expert analysis to the management highlighting technical concerns if any and recommend the optimum terms to support negotiations with the vendors.

· Create architecture specifications and high-level design documentation for new or enhanced Group Digital & Cybersecurity Services for all Group Commercial & Financial business solutions.

Group Commercial & Financial Solutions Standards and Framework

· Conduct research and consolidate best practices in digital solutions management and ensure maintenance of an up-to-date internal best practice repository in line with the overall Group Digital & Cybersecurity framework.

· Collaborate with the corporate Group Digital & Cybersecurity Security function to develop the guidelines and policies for the Group Commercial & Financial solutions to ensure that all Group Digital & Cybersecurity solutions are following the defined framework.

· Provide support in disaster recovery planning to ensure alignment with the business continuity plan from the information security.

· Validate compliance of related Group Digital & Cybersecurity projects and (internally or externally) developed solutions with architectural standards and principles.

· Analyse and improve data and application architecture to provide end-to-end (cross-application) support.

Group Commercial & Financial Solution Development

· Lead the development program/projects for Group Commercial & Financial solutions ensuring efficient and effective project management and considering all factors like approach/integration, scope, time, cost, quality, people, communications, risks management, and procurement to meet business needs.

· Provide expertise to achieve business/ technical / operational efficiency by setting up a consistent and integrated organisation wide information model facilitating the integration, security, shareability and accessibility of all Group Commercial & Financial information.

· Plan, organize, manage, and control various stages in the business application development project life cycle in order to ensure its timely completion, meeting agreed project parameters, standards and objectives.

· Design and implement test plans (in collaboration with vendor representatives and internal clients) and conduct User Acceptance Testing and accurately document all outcomes to ensure the functionality and viability of the solution being delivered.

Group Commercial & Financial Solutions Delivery

· Conduct the analysis, scope development, technical evaluations, and prototyping, developing, implementing, and delivering solutions

· Capture business requirements related to the Group Commercial & Financial domain.

· Ensure the delivery of the vertical’s business requirements and services according to the Company standards and strategies.

· Support the vertical’s business users and beyond in line with pre-set SLAs and delivery guidelines.

· Lead the development, implementation and support of high quality and cost-effective Group Commercial & Financial solutions and services deemed critical to the business operations.

· Ensure that the Group Commercial & Financial solutions section meet the appropriate service level agreements established with internal and group users’ functions. Also, that the services delivered by the engaged external organizations are delivered within the agreed service levels.

· Ensure that all deployed Group Commercial & Financial solutions have followed a comprehensive testing and quality assurance process, quality assurance reviews and have fulfilled the Group Digital & Cybersecurity Unit services release process requirements.

· Ensure that the enterprise architecture principles, data management and information security standards are applied throughout the solution development and implementation lifecycles.

· Report to the digital Solutions management on the progress of assigned programs and projects against plans, in terms of schedule, resources and cost.

· Ensure that all programs and projects are managed in compliance with the Projects Management Methodology and related standards.

Conduct systems' pre-deployment activities

· Conduct feasibility studies, assess business requirements and assist in designing business processes for small to large systems and implementations. Submit findings and recommendations for review, evaluation and approval by digital and Business management. Lead feasibility studies of digital Programs undertaken within the Unit wherever required.

· Analyse functional requirements including input transactions, output reports, functional processes, etc. and recommend solutions and process improvements for user approval to establish functional specifications.

· Perform impact analysis for new development to ensure synchronization and integration of cross functional business solutions and systems.

· Support in the development of business cases and projects initiation documentations and artifacts.

Evaluate new solutions and services

· Evaluate off-the-shelf packages to ascertain the degree of fitness with existing business processes and recommends appropriate solutions to business requirements.

· Technically support the existing ERP and other enterprise solutions implementations

· Wherever required, develop the required interfaces between various solutions while ensuring systems and data availability, integrity and service continuity.

· Develop fit-for-purpose and secure software programs. Test them to ensure their fulfilment of business requirements and their compliance with ADNOC Group digital standards and policies.

· Receive, assess, and prioritize change requests from the existing digital services owners and users.

Solution Upgrade & Maintenance

· Plan and implement maintenance and enhancement initiatives of existing Group Commercial & Financial solutions through the phases of structured system analysis and design life cycle to meet the Company’s changing business requirements.

· Provide technical expertise and on-site presence, including data backup recovery in accordance with established SLAs. Plan and test the Contingency and Disaster Recovery activities to maintain service levels and ensure the continuous operation of the information services.

· Conduct feasibility studies for adopting new tools for systems development and support. Analyse and develop technical justifications for adoption of new projects in order to optimize solutions in line with best fitted technology.

jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Role Purpose

The Senior Product Quality Engineer holds product approval authority for supplier-manufactured parts across Powertech propulsion programs, including turbofan, microjet and piston engines.

The role reviews and approves supplier advanced product quality planning, production part approval and first article inspection submissions, defines inspection and acceptance requirements, and coordinates configuration and change management between Design Engineering, Supply Chain and suppliers.

The Senior Product Quality Engineer works closely with Industrialization & Supplier Development, Metrology & Inspection Engineering, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Assembly and supplier quality teams, and provides technical leadership to junior Product Quality Engineers.

RESPONSIBILITIES


Product Approval & Gate Authority

• Review and approve supplier APQP submissions including process flow diagrams, PFMEA, control plans and measurement systems analysis, in line with AS9145.

• Review and approve production part approval (PPAP) packages against the agreed submission level, and issue written approval prior to serial delivery.

• Review and approve first article inspection reports in accordance with AS9102, including ballooned drawings, characteristic accountability and actual measured results.

• Determine full or partial FAI requirements arising from design, process, material, tooling, location or sub-tier changes, and from production lapses.

• Hold approval gates closed where evidence is insufficient, and articulate the technical basis for the decision to program and commercial stakeholders.

• Review supplier quality requirement compliance and assess supplier submissions against contracted obligations.

Inspection Planning & Acceptance Definition

• Define inspection and acceptance requirements for supplier-manufactured parts, including sampling strategy, inspection method and acceptance criteria.

• Develop and issue incoming inspection plans to Assembly, and support validation of inspection methods and gauging.

• Define key characteristics with Design Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering, and ensure they are correctly flowed to suppliers and reflected in control plans.

• Review measurement systems analysis and gauge capability evidence supporting product acceptance.

• Assess supplier process capability evidence against Cpk requirements on designated key characteristics.

Nonconformance, Material Review & Concession

• Create and administer material review records during new product introduction, and coordinate disposition with Design Engineering as design authority.

• Review supplier concession and deviation requests, assess technical justification and containment, and coordinate approval.

• Review supplier 8D submissions and verify effectiveness of corrective actions, including read-across to similar parts and processes.

• Support Supply Chain on serial-phase nonconformance matters requiring product approval or configuration expertise.

Configuration & Change Management

• Coordinate design change implementation with Design Engineering, Supply Chain and suppliers, ensuring changes reach suppliers only through released, revision-controlled drawings and formal change notices.

• Assess change classification and determine resulting FAI, PPAP and inspection plan impacts.

• Verify supplier acknowledgement of change notices, implementation dates and serial or batch cut-in points.

• Maintain product approval status records and configuration traceability for assigned part numbers.

Supplier Quality Engagement

• Participate in supplier gate reviews and industrialization reviews as the product approval authority.

• Conduct on-site product audits and source inspection where required, including verification of inspection practice and records.

• Support supplier readiness for product approval submissions without assuming responsibility for their preparation.

Technical Leadership

• Act as technical authority for product approval and acceptance within the team.

• Mentor Product Quality Engineer I and II staff and support their development.

• Develop and standardize product approval procedures, review checklists and acceptance criteria.

• Report product approval status, submission quality trends and escape data to management.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Manufacturing, Materials or Metrology Engineering.

• 6+ years of experience in aerospace quality, supplier quality, product quality or manufacturing engineering.

• Demonstrated authority-level experience reviewing and approving APQP, PPAP (AS9145) and first article inspection (AS9102) packages.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Strong GD&T application, tolerance interpretation and drawing analysis capability.

• Practical metrology competence — CMM, optical and contact measurement, gauge design principles, measurement systems analysis.

• Working knowledge of statistical process control and process capability assessment.

• Experience of nonconformance and material review processes, concession management and structured problem solving (8D).

• Sound understanding of manufacturing processes for machined, sheet metal fabricated and cast aerospace components, sufficient to assess submissions critically.

• Working knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace special process requirements.

• Experience of configuration and change management in a regulated engineering environment.

• Demonstrated ability to hold approval decisions under schedule and commercial pressure while maintaining constructive supplier relationships.

• Willingness to travel to supplier sites.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview

Inception is seeking a highly proficient and accomplished Applied Scientist, with a proven track record, to develop efficient deep-learning and generative AI algorithms and conceive innovative AI-centric models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with our product development teams, applying emerging technologies across a diverse range of applications

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

In the Applied Scientist role you will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. Your work will involve the creation and optimization of cutting-edge AI algorithms and deep learning models, contributing to advancements in areas such as semantic understanding, multidimensional data interpretation, and human-machine interactions. Furthermore, your innovative efforts will be applied to a spectrum of practical use cases, serving pivotal industries such as finance, oil and gas, environmental science, and healthcare, thereby driving forward the frontier of impactful AI solutions in real-world scenarios.

• Engage in the design, analysis and optimization of foundational and applied research to power the state-of-the-art AI algorithms and model capabilities at Inception. This will involve staying well-informed of emerging trends, understanding and manipulating complex datasets, and conceptualizing models that are both innovative and applicable to real-world scenarios.

• Work on comprehensive solutions that integrate various modalities, including text, audio, and visual data, enhancing the AI's ability to understand and interpret human interaction in a more nuanced manner.

• Collaborate with researchers and engineers across teams at Inception for the design, development, and continual improvement of AI algorithms, ensuring the implementations of such algorithms are optimized for efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Work alongside product development teams to integrate new algorithms and models into broader product offerings, and conduct proofs of concept (POC) as per client needs, ensuring that these innovations translate into tangible benefits for users and stakeholders.

• Propose scenarios where AI techniques could improve the efficiency of the customer’s business.

• Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

The criteria for your success would include cost savings achieved, number of use cases investigated & datasets mined, number of innovations/POCs deployed, number of existing processes optimized, and customer NPS.

To qualify, you must have

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.

• Minimum 6 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities

• Track record of conducting high-level research, preferably evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals or a history of product-driven research and development.

Ideally, you’ll also need

• A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving

• In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning

• Excellent communication skills

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: 3rd Party Developer Hub Manager
jobs.summary: Embrace the role of a Third Party Development Hub Manager and lead the integration of external developers and investors into our Mobility Hub. Drive commercial structuring, contract negotiation, and risk management while ensuring operational readiness and portfolio optimization. Shape the future of our distribution hub with your expertise in project governance and stakeholder management.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Lead third-party development within ADNOC Distribution’s Mobility Hub strategy by originating, structuring, and coordinating investor/developer projects from concept to handover. Act as the single point of contact for external developers and investors, managing the commercial, technical, contractual, and governance requirements needed to integrate sites seamlessly into the Hub ecosystem. Ensure timely approvals, risk-controlled delivery, and operational readiness that strengthen customer experience and portfolio returns.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Job Specific Accountabilities

Partnership Origination & Commercial Structuring

• Identify and qualify 3P development opportunities aligned to hub typologies, network priorities, and investment criteria.
• Prepare and refine commercial models, heads of terms, and term-sheet options to balance value creation, risk allocation, and compliance.
• Coordinate internal inputs (Finance, Legal, BD) to validate business cases, sensitivity scenarios, and approval requirements.
• Support investor due diligence (technical, commercial, regulatory), addressing queries and aligning key assumptions.
• Draft and socialize decision packs for governance forums, ensuring clear options, risks, and recommendations.

Contract Lifecycle & Risk Management

• Lead the end-to-end contract process—from RFI/RFP support and bid clarifications to negotiation of definitive agreements.
• Ensure clarity on roles, deliverables, milestones, warranties, performance securities, and exit/step-in provisions.
• Track contractual obligations and conditions precedent (CPs), coordinating timely closure with internal and external parties.
• Maintain a live risk register covering commercial, schedule, technical, HSE, and authority risks, with mitigation plans.
• Manage variations and change control, preserving scope, economics, and governance integrity.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Technical Alignment

• Align site layout, access, utilities, and design standards with Engineering Projects, Operations, HSE, and Property Services.
• Coordinate authority requirements (utility providers, municipality, civil defense, etc.) to de-risk approvals on the critical path.
• Ensure 3P specifications support hub customer experience (wayfinding, parking circulation, tenant adjacencies, brand touchpoints).
• Validate readiness criteria for construction start (permits, insurances, method statements, interfaces).
• Facilitate technical reviews and close-out of comments to keep design and procurement on schedule.

Delivery Governance & Operational Readiness

• Run a stage-based governance cadence (business case, design freeze, pre-award, start-up, pre-opening) with documented gate criteria.
• Track execution milestones, critical path, and dependencies; escalate slippage early and propose recovery actions.
• Coordinate with Operations and HSE on commissioning, OR checklists, training/handovers, and defects management.
• Validate as-built documentation, warranties, and O&M manuals prior to handover into steady-state operations.
• Capture lessons learned and feed improvements into playbooks and templates.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

• Serve as the single point of contact for developers/investors, providing clear updates, action logs, and decisions required.
• Prepare concise progress reports, dashboards, and risk summaries for EMT/ELT and relevant committees.
• Coordinate with Marketing/Brand on key milestones and external communications where applicable.
• Ensure records are audit-ready (approvals, contracts, CP closures, change logs, correspondence).
• Maintain confidentiality and adherence to governance, delegation of authority (DoA), and information security standards.

Portfolio Performance & Optimization

• Monitor post-launch performance (throughput, uptime, commercial KPIs) and identify improvement opportunities with partners.
• Recommend re-scoping or enhancement measures (amenity mix, access improvements, utilities optimization) to maximize returns.
• Track contractual performance measures (SLAs, liquidated damages where applicable) and manage under-performance remedies.
• Support periodic portfolio reviews and rebalancing of pipeline priorities based on performance and market dynamics.
• Contribute to strategy refreshes, investment theses, and international roll-out playbooks as required.

Continuous Improvement & Tools

• Maintain and enhance standard templates (term sheets, risk registers, gate checklists, CP trackers, and reporting packs).
• Promote use of digital tools for document control, schedule tracking, and stakeholder collaboration.
• Benchmark external practices to refine commercial structures and execution standards.
• Propose process simplifications that reduce cycle time without compromising assurance.
• Support training and knowledge-sharing sessions across the Franchise & Property Services Division.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Real Estate, or a related field.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

• 8 years of relevant experience in commercial real‑estate development, PPP/3P projects, or mobility/retail infrastructure.
• Hands‑on experience in commercial modelling, contract negotiation, and approvals (CPs, permits, utilities).
• Strong exposure to design coordination and delivery governance (stage‑gates, risk, change control).
• Proven ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders and counterparties to deadlines.
• Commercial acumen (term sheets, risk allocation, value drivers)
• Contracting & negotiation; change/claims awareness
• Technical literacy (layouts, utilities, basic MEP/HSE considerations)
• Project governance, planning, and risk management
• Executive‑level communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence
• Strong documentation, decision‑pack preparation, and audit‑readiness
• Proficiency with MS Office and project/collaboration tools (e.g., MS Project, SharePoint/Teams, Asana/Jira)

locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Take on the role of Senior Manager - Information Technology to lead the strategic planning and maintenance of IT infrastructure, ensuring robust cybersecurity and alignment with business goals. Oversee hybrid workspaces and vendor relationships, requiring significant experience in cloud platforms and endpoint security. Ideal for a senior IT leader with deep expertise in enterprise environments.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


Senior Manager - Information Technology

Position Overview

The Senior IT Manager will lead the strategic planning, implementation, and maintenance of the organization’s IT infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations, robust cybersecurity, and alignment with business goals. This role requires expertise in managing hybrid workspaces, vendor relationships, network/application maintenance, and cybersecurity frameworks. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with endpoint security tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, Forcepoint), cloud platforms (Azure, Windows 365), and infrastructure components (AD/Entra ID, VDIs, firewalls).

Responsibilities:


Responsibilities

• Design and implement enterprise-level solutions for endpoint and workplace management, encompassing user devices, and core enterprise services such as Active Directory, domain management, DNS, DHCP, networking, security, network devices, and WiFi infrastructure.
• Oversee Azure cloud environments, including management of Entra ID (Azure AD), Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), and Windows 365 (W365) deployments.
• Demonstrate proven experience in guiding organizations through ISO, SOC2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance and certification processes.
• Manage Security Operations Centers (SOC) and Network Operations Centers (NOC), ensuring a robust cybersecurity posture for AI-driven organizations
• Ensure high availability and performance of VDI environments and cloud-based workspaces.
• Implement and enforce InfoSec policies, including endpoint security controls (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender), firewalls, and content filtering for endpoints
• Lead patch and vulnerability management programs to mitigate risks and ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).
• Negotiate contracts and manage relationships with vendors, suppliers, and MSPs to meet SLAs for hardware, software, and cloud services.
• Monitor service delivery performance and resolve escalations promptly.
• Oversee the deployment, licensing, and lifecycle management of enterprise applications and software.
• Collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration of on-premises and cloud systems.
• Partner with facility teams to maintain IT infrastructure in office locations (e.g., network cabling, power management).
• Provide support for complex IT issues, ensuring minimal downtime and high customer satisfaction.
• Develop IT budgets, resource plans, and training programs.

Qualifications:


Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field (Master’s preferred).
• 15+ years of IT management experience, with 3+ years in a senior leadership role.
• Must possess strong people management abilities.
• Proven expertise in managing Azure cloud environments, Entra ID, and hybrid infrastructures.
• Experience with CrowdStrike, Forcepoint, Microsoft Defender, firewalls), content filtering, AD/Entra ID, VDIs, W365, patch management (e.g., SCCM, Intune), vulnerability scanners, Wi-Fi management, VPNs, SD-WAN, network monitoring tools
• Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on customer satisfaction.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audience.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Data Center Infra Engineer  - 2027 Internship
jobs.summary: Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary
jobs.description:
Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us!

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

- Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region

- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures

- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support

- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered

- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday to Thursday.

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life

0

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In the last year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or another equivalent technical discipline, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date

- Knowledge of Power Systems, Fluid Dynamics, and/or Thermodynamics

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems

- Coursework in commercial or industrial power systems and/or mechanical systems

- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
