jobs.title: AWS Solutions Architect - Kuwait Nationals
jobs.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that will have an opportunity to work with customers, account managers and several internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and help accelerate the adoption of AWS. In collaboration with sales, you will drive AWS platform adoption across a broad set of customers. 



As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. The ability to link technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.



For the Solutions Architect role, we are looking for a candidate who is comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. He or she will be broadly competent across many areas of technology and deep in a handful of areas. It's ok for them to be less deep in some places, but we need to feel confident that they have the fundamentals and the ability to learn complex new technologies quickly. 



On the business side, we are looking for excellent communication skills. The Solutions Architect will spend most of their day interacting with customers via email, phone, instant messaging, and in-person meetings. They will meet with developers, team leads, engineering directors, and CxOs. Given the large portion of customers who are self-served, interest in and ability to create one-to-many content such as reference architectures and blog posts is an important part of the role.



On the soft-skills side, we are looking for ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience and solid ability to pick up on non-verbal communication. Also ability to pick up on “un-said” drivers is important.



On the personal attributes side, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about technology and have the drive and capability to absorb and retain vast amounts of deep technical information continuously.





Job responsibilities

• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform

• Partner with the account management team, formulate and execute an account strategy.

• Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud

• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS

• Capture and share best-practice knowledge within the AWS solutions architect community

• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers

• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates

• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

jobs.description:
We are hiring a Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in central Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS's growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as a key technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas.

Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also contribute to competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS.

You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and developing depth in at least 1–2 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers' successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers.

Key job responsibilities

- In partnership with Account Managers and Business Development, support long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions.

- Serve as a technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Riyadh and central Saudi Arabia region, building relationships with customer stakeholders and contributing to their technology strategy.

- Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS.

- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (e.g., Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays).

- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures.

- Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support — gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and collaborating with fellow Solutions Architects in the region.

A day in the life

As a Solutions Architect in Riyadh, your day revolves around customer impact. You might start the morning reviewing an architecture proposal for an enterprise customer exploring a migration from on-premises or competing cloud platforms to AWS. Mid-morning, you join a technical session with a customer's engineering team, working through a solution design for their application platform and advising on the right mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services.

After lunch, you collaborate with your Account Manager and the wider account team on a strategy call — contributing to the technical win plan for a competitive opportunity and identifying the right Specialist SAs or ProServe resources to bring in. Later in the afternoon, you might support a workshop or Immersion Day for a group of developers at a customer site, walking them through hands-on labs on Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernisation with EKS.

Between customer meetings, you capture feedback on product gaps, contribute to a blog post on a solution pattern, or review an architecture alongside a teammate. Your week also includes internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, community knowledge-sharing sessions, and preparation for upcoming events. No two days are the same, but the constant is clear: you are a trusted technical partner for your customers, and your work directly drives their success on AWS.

About the team

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Cloud Services
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Engineer - Cloud Services

The Big Picture  

About Sysco LABS: 

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry. 

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion. 

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations. 

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer. 

Role Overview

As a Senior Engineer of Sysco’s Global Public Cloud Engineering Team, you will own and support our multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure and service transformation. You will assist the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, Fastly (CDN/WAF) and Cloud Governance Platforms focusing relentlessly on cloud-native patterns and the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO). Blending hands-on engineering execution with technical leadership, you will set enterprise standards for Infrastructure-as-Code, automated governance, edge security, and developer enablement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Cloud Transformation

• Act as point of contact for multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure services transformation, establishing architecture standards and golden patterns for provisioning and deployment.

• Support cloud-native solutions over legacy lift-and-shift patterns, aligning all designs with the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability).

• Design and implement enterprise cloud architectures, develop cloud landing zones and platform capabilities, design hybrid-cloud and multi-cloud connectivity.

• Define and own end-to-end Solution Architecture (Infrastructure, applications, and data technologies) utilizing service-oriented architecture principles.

• Assist migration initiatives, including On-Premises-to-Cloud and Cloud-to-Cloud migrations with zero downtime architectures and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) validation.

• AI Infrastructure & Workload Support: Support robust, scalable, and secure underlying cloud infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (including GPU-optimized nodes, vector database connectivity, and secure model serving endpoints) across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

• AI-Assisted Engineering Productivity: Help the secure adoption of AI-driven developer tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) within infrastructure teams, establishing safety guardrails for automated code and Infrastructure-as-Code generation.

• ITIL-Aligned Cloud Engineering/Operations: Bridge modern cloud engineering practices with IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks (ITIL v4 or above), ensuring rapid deployment velocity is balanced with robust service quality, predictability, and risk control.

2. Governance, Security & Compliance

• Design and enforce enterprise Cloud Governance strategies, implementing automated guardrails and continuous compliance using Cloud Custodian and native cloud policies (e.g., AWS SCPs, Azure Policies).

• Support comprehensive Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM), tenant isolation, federated authentication, and least-privilege security models.

• Partner with security teams to configure and manage enterprise edge security architectures, integrating Fastly CDN and NFWAF (Next-Gen WAF) to protect core applications from modern web threats.

• Ensure end-to-end security and regulatory compliance across all enterprise infrastructure, data pipelines, and application configurations.

• AI Governance & Policy-as-Code: Extend Cloud Custodian and native cloud governance engines to audit, monitor, and enforce compliance policies on cloud-hosted AI and generative AI services, preventing unauthorized shadow AI deployments.

• AI Security & Data Privacy: Partner with security teams to ensure secure data pipelines, strict API rate-limiting, and egress/ingress protection via Fastly CDN and NFWAF for enterprise AI applications. Implement FinOps guardrails specifically tailored for high-cost AI/ML resource consumption.

3. DevOps, Automation & CI/CD Excellence

• Standardize and govern Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and Terragrunt for modular, DRY multi-cloud deployments.

• Optimization and management of CI/CD pipelines, driving adoption toward GitHub and GitHub Actions while managing legacy Jenkins maintenance.

• Develop advanced automation scripts and custom orchestration tools using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.

• Ability to support configuration management frameworks and server baseline standards using Ansible, alongside containerized runtime workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

4. Technical Leadership & Engineering Support

• Troubleshoot critical production issues, perform root cause analyses, and drive technical problem-solving across cross-functional engineering squads.

• Conducting rigorous code and Pull Request (PR) reviews for Terraform configurations and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and maintain comprehensive internal knowledge bases, technical documentation, and reusable architecture decision records (ADRs).

• Articulate technical risks, cost-capacity ratios, and strategic roadmaps clearly to audiences ranging from operations engineers to executive stakeholders.

• Internal Platform Development – In-house cloud platform management solutions development - Develop self-service platform capabilities etc.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent.

• 4+ years of total progressive industry experience in IT infrastructure and software delivery.

• 2+ years of dedicated hands-on cloud engineering, platform design, or operational experience.

• Proven track record of hands-on experience across at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). Experience in two cloud vendors would be an advantage.

Technical Competencies

• Thorough understanding or core cloud foundational services (networking/VPC peering, enterprise IAM, hybrid connectivity, compute, and container runtimes) across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a proven ability to design and manage resilient, high-performance multi-cloud platforms.

• Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Terragrunt) and modern CI/CD ecosystems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

• Strong working knowledge of configuration management and automation frameworks (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible).

• Understanding of networking, CDN caching tiers, WAF configurations (i.e. Fastly CDN, NGWAF), and hybrid cloud connectivity.

• Experience in implementing/supporting cloud security controls, encryption (at rest and in transit), key management systems, vulnerability assessments, and SIEM integrations.

• AI Governance & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with supporting governance, security controls, and resource optimization for cloud-native AI/ML services.

• Responsible AI & Compliance: Understanding of data residency, privacy frameworks, and security baselines required when deploying AI models in enterprise multi-cloud environments.

• ITSM & ITIL Frameworks: Solid working knowledge of ITIL principles, particularly concerning change enablement, incident management, problem management, and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) tracking in multi-cloud architectures.

Certifications & Soft Skills

• Cloud Certifications: Active certification from at least one major cloud provider at the minimum of Associate/Engineer level.

• Infrastructure Automation Certifications: Having HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (or higher Authoring and Operations Professional) is an added advantage.

• Service Management: Certification in ITIL v4 Foundation or above would be an added advantage.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation abilities; adept at translating complex architectural trade-offs and risks into business terms for executive leadership.

Benefits:  

• Performance-based annual bonus  

• Performance rewards and recognition  

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes  

• Entertainment allowance  

• Team engagement allowance  

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws  

• Hybrid work arrangement  

  

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering robust, secure, and highly available networking solutions supporting mission-critical environments, including technical security systems, C4ISR platforms, command centers, surveillance systems, access control solutions, RF technologies, and unmanned systems. • AI-curious.

• Prior exposure to commercial responsibilities such as pricing, monetisation, or P&L ownership.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. Halcon is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer: Software (Embedded Software System Engineer) to lead the definition, architecture, and integration of high-performance real-time embedded software systems.
The role serves as the technical authority bridging system requirements, software architecture, hardware interfaces, and software development teams.The successful candidate will drive software system engineering activities, ensure compliance with system requirements, mentor engineers, and support the development of scalable and safety-critical embedded solutions for advanced defense and aerospace platforms.

jobs.title: AVP, Trade Support - Dealer Assist & Data Readiness
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION

The role supports the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support by managing day-to-day Dealer Assist and Data Readiness activities across Global Markets products, ensuring Front Office Sales and Trading desks receive timely, accurate and consistent operational support. The role coordinates client ready-to-trade activities, product activation readiness, counterparty setup, account and portfolio readiness, static/reference data dependencies, SSI enrichment requirements and new product operational readiness from a Trade Support perspective. The role manages T0 Dealer Assist requests, trade booking support queries, allocation support, enrichment follow-up, affirmation/confirmation monitoring support and settlement-readiness dependencies, ensuring timely escalation and hand-off to relevant owner functions. The role works closely with Front Office, GM MO Trade Support, Operations, KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Technology, Product Control, Market Risk and regional teams to remove blockers, improve service quality and support scalable trade execution support.The role does not own independent Control & Governance responsibilities such as trading permissions controls, booking template controls, off-market monitoring, counterparty exposure monitoring, reconciliations, collateral management, regulatory reporting, RCSA/KRI ownership or control effectiveness testing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Dealer Assist Operating Discipline
• Execute and coordinate daily Dealer Assist activities in line with approved service standards, request channels, escalation protocols and handover routines.
• Manage Front Office request intake, triage, prioritisation, allocation and follow-up across assigned products, desks or regional coverage points.
• Support trade booking queries, client account allocations, portfolio allocations, sales-support requests and trade-flow coordination required by Sales and Trading desks.
• Maintain request logs, workload trackers, escalation records and service commentary to support transparent service management.
Identify recurring Dealer Assist issues, process gaps and capacity constraints, and escalate improvement opportunities to the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support.
• Client Activation and Ready-to-Trade Coordination
• Coordinate client onboarding and ready-to-trade activities with KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Operations and Front Office teams.
• Track client, counterparty, product, account, portfolio, SSI, static data and reference-data dependencies required for trading enablement.
Support product activation and counterparty activation by coordinating required data, documentation, system setup and stakeholder actions.
Escalate onboarding blockers, incomplete setup items, documentation gaps and system-readiness issues impacting Front Office execution.
Maintain readiness trackers and provide timely updates on open actions, owners, deadlines and risks to trade readiness.
• Data Readiness and Static / Reference Data Coordination
• Support static data, reference data, market data and SSI readiness activities required for accurate trade booking, enrichment, validation and downstream processing.
• Coordinate with Reference Data, Technology, Operations, Market Risk and relevant owner functions to resolve data-quality or setup issues impacting trade support.
• Perform completeness checks on operational data dependencies and ensure items are appropriately routed, tracked and escalated.
Support new product operational readiness by coordinating data, system and workflow dependencies from a Trade Support perspective.
Identify recurring data-readiness issues and support root-cause analysis, remediation actions and process standardisation.
T0 Trade Support and Enrichment Support
• Support T0 trade support activities including non-economic booking support, enrichment follow-up, allocation support and trade-flow coordination.
Coordinate with T0 Validation teams to ensure required trade-support information is complete and available for validation, affirmation, confirmation and settlement-readiness processes.
• Support Front Office queries relating to booking support, account/portfolio mapping, SSI enrichment, missing data and trade-support dependencies.
Escalate aged, urgent or high-impact trade support items to the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support and relevant owner functions.
Ensure unresolved control, reconciliation, collateral, regulatory or risk-monitoring matters are handed off to GM MO Control & Governance or other owner functions as appropriate.
• Affirmation, Confirmation and Settlement-Readiness Support
• Monitor assigned affirmation and confirmation support items, coordinating follow-up with relevant teams where trade-support information is required.
Support settlement-readiness by ensuring account setup, allocation, SSI, enrichment and required non-economic data dependencies are complete or escalated.
• Coordinate with Operations, Trade Support, Product Control, Front Office and regional teams to resolve trade-support dependencies that may impact timely downstream processing.
• Track open support items, commentary, owner actions and escalation status to support daily service discipline.
Contribute to reduction of recurring trade-support issues by identifying upstream data, booking or workflow causes.
Stakeholder Management and Service Delivery
• Act as a day-to-day Trade Support contact for Front Office Sales and Trading desks on Dealer Assist and data-readiness matters.
Coordinate across KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Technology, Operations, Product Control and regional teams to remove trade-support blockers.
• Maintain clear communication on service status, pending actions, escalation requirements and expected next steps.
Support effective hand-offs between Dealer Assist, T0 Validation, Operations and GM MO Control & Governance functions.
Promote a service-oriented culture focused on responsiveness, accuracy, ownership, clear escalation and Front Office enablement.
Reporting, MI and Service Inputs
• Prepare inputs for Trade Support service reporting, operational dashboards, request volumes, SLA adherence, backlog ageing and recurring issue themes.
• Provide accurate commentary on client readiness, data-readiness blockers, Dealer Assist activity and trade-support escalation items.
• Maintain request and readiness trackers to support management visibility and service performance analysis.
• Contribute to KPI and service-quality inputs required by the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support.
• Support standardized MI and dashboard enhancements for Trade Support and Data Readiness activities.
• Process Improvement, Automation and UAT
• Identify opportunities to simplify request management, reduce manual hand-offs, improve data-readiness tracking and enhance service visibility.
• Participate in UAT, workflow design, dashboard development and automation initiatives impacting Dealer Assist and Data Readiness processes.
• Support standardization of templates, request categories, escalation formats, handover processes and operating procedures.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance STP, service quality, capacity and operational scalability.
• Support knowledge transfer and cross-training across Dealer Assist, Data Readiness and T0 Validation teams.
• People, Capability and Coverage Support
• Coach Specialists were assigned and support day-to-day task allocation, workload balancing and service discipline within the Dealer Assist & Data Readiness team.
• Support cross-product capability building across FX/MM, Derivatives, Commodities, Capital Markets and other applicable products.
Assist in documenting procedures, process maps, checklists and training materials for Trade Support activities.
• Promote accountability, ownership, timely escalation and consistent service standards across the team.
•
Support succession planning, coverage resilience and cross-training initiatives led by the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support.

Key Working Relationships

• Internal stakeholders include the VP & Head of GM MO Trade Support, Head of Global Markets Middle Office, GM MO Control & Governance, Front Office
• Sales and Trading desks, Global Markets Operations, Product Control, Market Risk, Finance, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Credit, KYC, GM Documentation, Reference Data and regional Middle Office teams.
•
External stakeholders may include clients, counterparties, custodians, brokers, clearing channels or market infrastructure providers where Dealer Assist or Data Readiness coordination is required to support client readiness, trade readiness, affirmation, confirmation or settlement-readiness activities.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline; professional qualification preferred.
• 7+ years of experience in Global Markets Operations, Middle Office, Trade Support, Dealer Assist, Client Onboarding, Reference Data, Front Office support or related operational support functions.
• Strong understanding of Global Markets products including FX, Money Markets, Rates, Derivatives, Commodities, Capital Markets and structured products.
• Good knowledge of trade lifecycle processes including client readiness, product activation, counterparty setup, trade booking support, enrichment, validation, affirmation, confirmation and settlement-readiness support.
• Experience coordinating with Front Office, KYC, Credit, Compliance, GM Documentation, Reference Data, Technology, Operations, Product Control and regional teams.
• Practical knowledge of systems and platforms such as Murex, Bloomberg, MarkitWire / matching platforms, reference-data tools, workflow trackers and dashboard tools.
• Strong stakeholder management, prioritisation, communication, escalation, documentation and service-delivery skills.
•
Experience supporting process standardization, automation, UAT, operating-model change or service improvement.

Preferred / Beneficial

• Professional qualification preferred.
• Skills
• Global Markets Trade Support
• Dealer Assist operating model
• Client activation and ready-to-trade processes
• Product and counterparty activation
• Static, SSI and reference data coordination
• Market data readiness coordination
• Trade booking support and allocations
• Account and portfolio mapping support
• Trade enrichment support
• Same-Day Validation support inputs
• Affirmation and confirmation monitoring support
• Settlement-readiness dependencies
• FX/MM, Rates, Derivatives and Commodities lifecycle
• Murex, Markit Wire and Bloomberg knowledge
• Queue management and SLA tracking
• Handover discipline and request management
• Process improvement and STP mindset
• UAT, workflow automation and dashboard requirements
• Cross-functional stakeholder management
• Service performance reporting
• Service excellence
• Front Office partnership
• Execution discipline
• Attention to detail
• Clear communication
• Stakeholder management
• Accountability and ownership
• Prioritizations under pressure
• Issue-resolution focus
• Collaboration across function
• Ability to manage multiple requests
• Coaching and knowledge sharing
• Ability to work across products, regions and teams.

jobs.title: VP & Head of Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight - Group Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION
VP, Head of Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight — Group Technology & Transformation
The VP, Head of Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight — Group Technology & Transformation operates as a Second Line of Defence role within the Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight (ORA) function, under the direction of the SVP, Head of Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight.
The purpose of the role is to lead portfolio-specific ORA coverage for the Group Technology & Transformation (GT&T) portfolio, ensuring that operational risks relating to technology services, platforms, infrastructure, data analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, information risk, change and transformation are effectively identified, assessed, challenged, escalated and governed in line with the Group Operational Risk Framework, risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
The role executes the ORA coverage model and priorities defined at Group level, providing independent challenge and subject matter expertise to senior GT&T stakeholders, while maintaining clear separation from first-line ownership, technology delivery, control operation, remediation and independent assurance.
The role acts as the designated portfolio lead and subject matter expert within ORA for technology, information risk, technology resilience, data and analytics risk and AI-related operational risk considerations, escalating material matters to the SVP where enterprise-level alignment, interpretation or governance positioning is required.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• The role operates within Group Risk policies, approved governance standards, delegated authorities and the Group Operational Risk operating model.
• The role is accountable for portfolio leadership, independent second-line challenge, stakeholder engagement, issue escalation, policy implementation oversight, thematic review execution and risk insight generation across the GT&T portfolio.
• Lead second-line Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight coverage for the GT&T portfolio, aligned to Group-wide operational risk priorities, minimum standards and the ORA coverage model.
• Act as the primary ORA point of engagement for senior GT&T leadership across BAU technology operations, platforms, infrastructure, data analytics, AI-enabled capabilities and change initiatives.
• Maintain a risk-based portfolio coverage plan reflecting technology service criticality, transformation activity, data and analytics priorities, AI-related operational risk considerations, third-party dependencies, resilience matters, incidents, open issues and regulatory developments.
• Provide portfolio insight and recommendations to the SVP where matters are material, systemic, cross-portfolio, regulatory-sensitive or require enterprise-level governance alignment.
• Provide independent second-line challenge over technology, information, data and transformation-related operational risks, including risk identification, assessment, control design, control effectiveness, risk acceptance, issue remediation and tolerance breaches.
• Challenge material risk acceptance decisions, control weaknesses, remediation plans and closure evidence, escalating to the SVP where risks are material, systemic or cross-cutting.
• Ensure challenge activity is evidence-based, proportionate, clearly documented and aligned to the Group Operational Risk Framework and applicable operational risk policies.
○ Technology and information risk assessments
○ RCSA outputs and control assessments for GT&T
○ Technology change, transformation and digital initiative assessments
○ Data management, analytics and AI-related operational risk assessments
○ Operational resilience assessments for technology services
○ Third-party and outsourcing risk matters relating to technology dependencies
○ Material incidents, root cause analysis and remediation plans
○ KRI breaches, tolerance exceptions and policy exceptions
• Act as the designated Line 2 subject matter expert within ORA for GT&T-related technology risk, information risk, technology resilience, data analytics risk and AI-related operational risk considerations.
• Provide SME input covering information confidentiality, integrity and availability, data protection, information security risk, technology control alignment, data management controls, analytics risks and operational risks associated with AI-enabled processes or technology capabilities.
• Provide SME input to enterprise thematic reviews, regulatory responses, supervisory engagements and material incident assessments led by the SVP or relevant governance owner.
• Support consistent second-line interpretation and challenge across technology platforms, change programmes, data and analytics capabilities and strategic transformation initiatives.
• Provide operational risk advisory and independent challenge over major technology programmes, digital initiatives, platform changes, data and analytics initiatives and AI-enabled transformation activities.
• Support second-line oversight of operational resilience within technology estates, including technology service mapping, dependency analysis, control embedding and scenario challenge, without assuming first-line ownership.
• Challenge whether material technology changes and transformation programmes appropriately consider operational resilience, information risk, data risk, third-party dependencies, control design and sustainable remediation.
• Identify systemic control weaknesses or recurring operational risk themes arising from technology change, transformation and resilience activity.
• Ensure timely identification, escalation and tracking of material GT&T operational risk issues, including technology, information, data, transformation, resilience and third-party dependency matters.
• Challenge issue ownership, target dates, remediation quality, closure evidence and sustainability of corrective actions.
• Escalate matters requiring enterprise-level consistency, interpretation, risk acceptance, committee positioning or senior management judgement to the SVP.
• Support preparation of portfolio-level reporting, committee materials, risk insight papers and escalation notes for relevant governance forums.
• Engage with senior GT&T management, technology leadership teams, risk committees, Internal Audit, assurance functions, Compliance and other relevant control partners.
• Support regulatory inspections, supervisory reviews and internal assurance activity within the GT&T, technology risk, information risk, operational resilience, data and analytics or AI-related operational risk scope, under the direction of the SVP.
• Provide practical second-line guidance to GT&T stakeholders on the application of operational risk requirements without assuming first-line ownership or execution responsibility.
• Maintain effective working relationships across Operational Risk, Framework & Governance, Data & Analytics, Technology, Cyber / Security, Strategic Vendor Management and other relevant functions.
• Provide leadership, direction and technical guidance to assigned AVP and Specialist resources supporting the GT&T portfolio.
• Support capability development, coaching, performance management, succession planning and knowledge sharing within the portfolio team.
• Review the quality of challenge outputs, thematic reviews, issue assessments and portfolio reporting prepared by team members.
• Act as a senior leader within Group Risk, modelling ethical behaviour, sound judgement, strong governance discipline and an effective risk culture.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable Group health, safety and wellbeing policies.
• Promote a safe, respectful and inclusive working environment within the function.
• The role operates within the Group Operational Risk Framework, approved policies, governance standards, Delegation of Authority and the ORA strategy and coverage model defined by the SVP, Head of Operational Risk Advisory & Oversight.
• The role is a Second Line of Defence function and provides independent advisory, oversight, challenge and escalation. It does not perform first-line execution, technology delivery, control operation, remediation ownership or independent assurance activities.
• Enterprise Operational Risk Framework, taxonomy, risk appetite methodology and framework governance ownership remain with the relevant framework and governance function. This role consumes those standards for portfolio advisory and challenge purposes.
• First Line of Defence retains accountability for technology delivery, risk ownership, control design, control operation, service resilience, data and analytics control operation and remediation.
• Independent validation or assurance activities remain with the relevant independent validation, audit or assurance functions. This role may use their output to inform second-line challenge but does not perform independent assurance.
• The role is authorised to make decisions and escalate matters in line with approved delegated authorities and second-line escalation protocols. Material, systemic, cross-portfolio or regulatory-sensitive issues are escalated to the SVP for enterprise-level governance and committee consideration.
REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Risk Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related discipline.
• 12–15+ years' relevant experience in financial services, technology risk, operational risk or complex regulated organisations.
• Significant experience in technology risk, information risk, operational risk, operational resilience, third-party technology risk, data management, data analytics risk or second-line risk advisory roles.
• Proven experience engaging with senior technology stakeholders, technology governance forums, risk committees, Internal Audit, assurance functions and regulators.
• Exposure to large-scale technology change, digital transformation, technology platforms, infrastructure, cloud or third-party technology dependency risk.

Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. • Participate in technical reviews, prepare engineering documentation, and mentor junior engineers on software development best practices.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in embedded software development with strong proficiency in C/C++.

• Hands-on experience with RTOS and/or bare-metal embedded systems, device drivers, and low-level hardware interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet).

• Experience with software verification, debugging tools, version control systems (Git/SVN), and requirements management tools such as DOORS or JAMA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Experience in defence, aerospace, aviation, missile systems, UAVs, or other safety-critical environments.

• Knowledge of MISRA C/C++ standards and familiarity with DO-178C software development and certification processes.

Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

jobs.title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship , DCEO
jobs.summary: Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical
jobs.description:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027 - before the end of the internship.

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in program or project management

- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems, controls)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer to join our expanding Data Centers (DC) Cloud regions. Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer is a hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation responder.

As an Engineering Operations Engineer, you will operate and maintain AWS DCs’ world-class mechanical and electrical infrastructure following a process-oriented approach. In addition, you will oversee facility operations and ensure the implementation of safety procedures.

If you like to apply your electrical and mechanical skills to solve problems while striving for operational excellence, we would like to meet you. Your work will help maintain availability for customers and ensure the upkeep and operation of the technical infrastructure in the DC.

Key job responsibilities

SAFETY

- Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. As a facility owner team, ensure remediation of safety risks/issues in conjunction with other teams. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster strong safety culture.

ENGINEERING & FACILITY OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE

- You will be supporting electrical and mechanical equipment, including Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS’s), Switchgear, Circuit Breakers, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS's), Diesel Generators, Chillers, Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC), Exhaust Fans, Variable Frequency Drives (VFD's), and Transformers.

- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, HVAC and fire/life safety equipment within the data center

- Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs

- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities

A day in the life

- Work rotational shifts of 4 days of 12 hours shifts (2 days followed by 2 nights), and 4 days off (including night, weekends and holidays) / Respond to on-call rotation reaction to off-duty emergency calls

- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log-taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)

- Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance

- Perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:

- Occasionally Move objects/material (weight limits in accordance with regulations)

- Work in outdoor weather conditions.

- Work in noisy environments

- Work at heights and from ladders

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or similar technical focus

- Knowledge of key electrical competencies and theory

- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Mechanical, HVAC systems, Controls)

Preferred qualifications
- 2+ years of data center engineering experience

jobs.title: Specialist, HC Data Analytics (OD&WFP Department)
jobs.summary: Exciting opportunity for a Specialist, HC Data Analytics to review and supervise workforce planning activities, develop workforce plan templates, and support nationalisation intake planning. Ideal for candidates with extensive experience in workforce planning and strong analytical skills.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE

Review, study, and supervise the workforce planning activities. Develop Workforce Plan templates for the companywide business units to ensure that all Functions have adequate human resources to fulfil their short, medium and long term objectives. Develop the company’s Nationalization intake plan in coordination with the concerned business units. Work in collaboration with the Talent Development Department to ensure that the integration plans of all Entry point Employees are included in the workforce business plan.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Workforce Planning

· Monitor the Company’s annual and long term workforce planning needs to ensure the development of realistic Workforce Plans.

· Supervise the development of the annual National intake and 10 years plans and ensure their alignment with the Company’s Emiratization targets.

· Ensure timely provision of accurate Workforce information that supports the Corporate Planning and decision making process.

· Ensure accurate information and statistics on vacant/critical positions in order to facilitate the development of the Annual Recruitment / Critical Emiratization Plan.

· Study the corporate headcount forecasts and ensure their alignment with the intended target. Provide recommendations in respect of costs’ minimization and other areas of interest.

· Validate the requisitions raised for the recruitment and employee status change to ensure the process alignment with the recruitment plan and availability of vacancies.

· Liaise with the Talent Development team to ensure that the integration plans of Entry Point Employees are in place.

· Monitor the effectiveness of the implemented automation features related to workforce planning dashboards and systems.

· Review and study the annual workforce 10 years Business Plan, and present analytical data into useful information to enable decision makers take action.

· Support Business units with workforce data to enable them appropriately prepare their inputs for the workforce business plan.

· Ensure that the workforce planning processes are efficient and in line with the Organisation structure and support the achievement of the company’s strategic objectives.

· Support external Consultants with the provision of organization information to facilitate the professional conduct of organisation and workforce studies in line with the company’s standards.

Workforce Budget

· Develop the Company annual workforce budget input and supervise its compilation to support the Workforce Planning process.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Minimum Qualification

· Bachelor Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration or an equivalent Professional Qualification..

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

· 9 years of experience in Workforce Planning/Human Resource Management, preferably in the Oil/Gas industry, including 4 years in supervisory roles.

· Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Extensive experience in workforce planning, headcount forecasting, and financial budgets.

· Experience in analyzing, organizing and directing positive organizational change.

· Knowledge in commercial / cost control.

· Experience in leveraging HR Systems/technology to create workforce analytics and metrics.

· Experience in developing and utilizing predictive analytics and statistical modelling.

· Root cause analysis skills.

· Experience in writing clear and analytic reports on workforce and positions.

· Understanding of applicable employment laws and regulations..

Ensure compliance with software development standards, quality assurance processes, and configuration management guidelines. Follow company policies, statutory regulations, and safety requirements.

Work in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines. Ability to work under pressure and extend working hours when required. jobs.description:
NO CYBERSECURITY, READ DESCRIPTION

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Amazon's data centers house the infrastructure that powers the world's largest cloud. Protecting them is mission-critical — and as a Security Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help ensure the physical security of these facilities from the inside.

You will drive operational security excellence, write reports, create presentations, and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Security Management, Criminology, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

About the Role

As a Security Specialist Intern, you will work within the Data Center Security team and play a hands-on role in the day-to-day physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures.

This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe.

What You Will Do

- Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning.

- Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements

- Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls

- Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms

- Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations for management

- Assist with planning and coordinating security-related projects

- Support incident documentation and follow-up processes

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help protect the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work protects the physical infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. The security operations you support keep Amazon's most critical facilities safe and running.

Action. You will move fast, analyze real security data, and make recommendations that get implemented. Your ideas do not stay theoretical — they get tested and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how physical security operates at world-class scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Risk Management, Criminology, Security Management, or a related field, graduating in 2027 - before the internship´s end date

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Strong communication skills

- Metrics oriented

- Ability to act swiftly and calmly in time of crisis

- Ability to handle confidential information with care

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


Role Summary

As the Director – Solution Engineering, you will lead the technical enablement, activation, and ongoing success of Inception’s partner ecosystem. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Solution Engineering, you will empower System Integrators, resellers, consulting partners, and technology alliances to effectively position, architect, and deliver Inception’s AI portfolio.

This role sits at the intersection of solution engineering, partner enablement, and scalable technical advocacy. You will build the frameworks, assets, and programs that allow partners to independently drive high-quality enterprise engagements. Your work will ensure that partners are deeply equipped—technically and commercially—to accelerate adoption of Inception’s AI capabilities across global markets.

Reusable Assets, Demo Environments & Tooling

· Ensure collateral is scalable, up-to-date, and aligned with Inception’s evolving AI portfolio.

Support for Partner-Led Customer Engagements

· Work closely with partners during customer engagements, providing guidance on workshops, RFx responses, architectural design, cost estimation, and solution sizing.

· Ensure partners are delivering technically sound proposals that align with Inception’s best practices and architectural principles.

· Serve as the escalation point for complex technical questions that arise in partner-led opportunities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Collaborate with product, applied science, engineering, and commercial teams to ensure alignment on partner needs and market feedback.

· Provide insights from partner engagements to influence product strategy and roadmap decisions.

· Support joint go-to-market initiatives with the partnerships and alliances teams.

Process Development & Standardization

· Develop scalable methodologies for partner technical onboarding, architecture reviews, and quality assurance.

· Standardize solution engineering processes and documentation across the partner ecosystem.

· Drive continuous improvement to ensure partners deliver high-quality, repeatable solutions.

Qualifications:


Skills & Attributes for Success

· Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI or software solutions.

· Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into scalable training materials and reusable assets.

· Deep understanding of AI/ML architectures, SaaS solutions, enterprise integration, and cloud-native technologies.

· Excellent presentation, communication, and technical mentoring skills.

· Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills across both technical and commercial audiences.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

· 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting—preferably with experience in partner enablement or partner ecosystems.

· Demonstrated success supporting enterprise sales engagements through technical architecture, workshops, and RFx responses.

· Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure strongly preferred), AI/ML services, and enterprise integration architectures.

· Technical knowledge of OpenAI and Microsoft Azure (L300) is a strong plus.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

To support the Tuning, Calibration & Analytics function within Financial Crime Operations by performing tuning, calibration, optimization and analytics activities across the Group’s sanctions screening and AML monitoring platforms. The role deploys and maintains fit-for-purpose screening and monitoring configurations, carries out periodic tuning and calibration to improve the quality and effectiveness of alerts while reducing false positives, and produces analytics and management information for defined stakeholders, taking into account global regulatory requirements and the Bank’s policies.

Key Accountabilities:

Job Specific Accountabilities

Policies, Systems, Process & Procedures

•
Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that the work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.

Continuous Improvement

•
Support the Tuning, Calibration & Analytics function within Financial Crime Operations in identifying continuous improvement and sustainability opportunities across the related systems, processes and practices.

•
Support the implementation of the Group’s sanctions screening and AML monitoring systems roadmap as agreed with Financial Crime Operations management and keep the VP & Head of Tuning, Calibration & Analytics updated.

•
Work proactively with Group IT and other stakeholders on screening and monitoring system projects to draw up BRD/FSD documentation and ensure fit-for-purpose sanctions screening and AML monitoring systems are designed.

•
Deliver mandated sanctions screening and AML monitoring tuning and optimization projects, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure smooth and proper delivery, and provide periodic status updates to the VP & Head of Tuning, Calibration & Analytics.

•
Deliver relevant user training to all the affected users to ensure smooth go live.

•
Ensure all relevant screening and monitoring system changes required in the existing platforms as per business requirements are well co-ordinated as change requests with Group IT, setting timelines, creating programme structures and installing/updating systems architecture where appropriate to support financial crime control capabilities for major changes.

•
Ensure fit-for-purpose algorithms, parameters, thresholds and rules are deployed for the Group as agreed with the VP & Head of Tuning, Calibration & Analytics and relevant stakeholders, and drive continuous tuning and calibration of screening and AML monitoring systems to improve the quality of alerts.

•
Ensure sanctions screening systems effectively screen information against Bank-approved global lists and individual country lists for all FAB locations locally and internationally.

Technology

•
Assist in producing procedures and processes aligned to Group Policy for the Tuning, Calibration & Analytics function within Financial Crime Operations.

•
Assist in exercises such as the design and system architecture of sanctions screening and AML monitoring systems by consulting with relevant business users.

•
Ensure proper UAT sessions and exercises for sanctions screening and AML monitoring system implementations.

•
Manage periodic testing of screening and AML monitoring systems, including data testing, quality and completeness, underlying models, logic, thresholds and rules etc.

Data Analysis

•
Perform periodic testing of payment/customer screening and AML monitoring systems to identify, record, risk assess and close gaps found.

•
Carry out ongoing tuning and calibration of payment/customer screening and AML monitoring systems to maintain consistency, appropriate efficiency and effectiveness.

•
In conjunction with the VP & Head of Tuning, Calibration & Analytics, provide support to all FAB’s local and international locations for country-specific configuration and the related performance of screening and monitoring systems, understanding and adequately addressing their requirements with regard to international sanctions and AML.

•
Advise and partner with related IT teams on system selections, minor or major systemic changes or upgrades, new system implementations, and any initiatives impacting the performance of the sanctions screening and AML monitoring systems.

Reporting

•
Collaborate with Financial Crime Operations SMEs to develop tuning, calibration and analytics MI dashboards.

•
Develop periodic reporting plan and maintain the schedule and workflow for multiple reports.

•
Populate management information dashboards by extracting relevant data from source systems including using logical queries and basic programming.

•
Collaborate with Financial Crime Operations colleagues to obtain information to populate dashboards.

•
Submit MI dashboards to the VP & Head of Tuning, Calibration & Analytics for review.

Minimum Qualification

•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Technology, Data Analytics or a related discipline. ICA, CAMS or equivalent Financial Crime Compliance certification is an advantage.

Minimum Experience

•
At least 4 years of experience in data analysis, data management and sanctions screening and/or AML monitoring systems, including tuning, calibration and threshold management.

•
Strong knowledge of sanctions, AML monitoring concepts and financial crime control environments.

•
Strong knowledge and experience of screening and monitoring platforms (e.g. Fircosoft filter, Firco Utilities and backends, or equivalent screening/AML monitoring tools).

Good knowledge of SQL and Power BI; scripting languages (Python, Bash, KSH, PowerShell) and exposure to machine learning or advanced analytics are a plus.

jobs.description:
​Charterhouse are working in partnership with a leading international event technology company, providing comprehensive, full-service solutions across the entertainment technology sector and supporting a diverse portfolio of local and international markets. Our client is looking to hire a Senior Infrastructure and Technology Engineer to join their Middle East team.

About the Role

The Senior Infrastructure & Technology Engineer will be responsible for maintaining, supporting and continuously improving the technology environment across the region. The role will provide hands-on expertise across infrastructure, networking, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, cybersecurity, business applications and end-user computing, as well as ensuring reliable, secure and resilient IT services while delivering 2nd and 3rd line technical support to employees and senior stakeholders.

In addition, the role will deliver local and regional technology projects, identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and evaluate emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and Microsoft Copilot. The Engineer will also coordinate with local and international vendors, communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will have 5+ years’ experience in a senior infrastructure, systems or technology operations role, with strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows Server, enterprise networking, cloud technologies, Active Directory and Entra ID. The candidate should have a proven track record delivering infrastructure projects, troubleshooting complex issues and providing excellent support to stakeholders, with strong communication and the ability to manage competing priorities. Experience with cybersecurity, AV technologies, automation, AI tools, ITIL or Cisco would be advantageous.
