jobs.title: VP & Head of Audit, Information Security
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

A subject matter expert responsible for planning and executing audits covering the activities and processes of Group Security Office (GSO), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Data Domain (Data Governance, Data Privacy, Data Analytics & AI), Group Technology (GT) & System Integration Projects domestically and in all international locations as well as related peripheral activities across the FAB Group. Thorough understanding of IS, IT, BCM, Data & Integration domains, business/ relationship aspects, risk management processes and the regulatory environment, both in UAE and other relevant jurisdictions where FAB operates and apply them to auditable areas to provide assurance to Management by identifying weaknesses; reporting and escalating significant Audit findings in a timely manner; and agreeing action plans to address the issues raised.

Act as the day-to-day contact with Management in GSO, GT and Data Functions and related areas influencing change through providing advice. As part of the GIA Extended Management Team (EMT), provide input to GIA on issues that have impact on the FAB Group as a whole. Conduct special investigations, reviews, additional tasks as and when required by GCAO / EVP / SVP.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Strategic Contribution

▪ Lead audits of FAB Group’s Information Security, BCM, Information Technology, Data Domain (Data Governance,

Data Privacy, Data Analytics & AI) & System Integration functions and related activities in the UAE and across the

international network (functional). Furthermore, Group Subsidiaries with Information Security, Technology, BCM,

Data Domain and System Integration presence will be covered.

▪ Ensure that audits in Information Security, BCM, Data Domain (Data Governance, Data Privacy, Data Analytics &

AI) & System Integration areas are conducted in accordance with the objectives laid down in the Annual Plan and

ensure that the work program is completed in an efficient and effective manner on or ahead of schedule. Inform

Head of Audit of any potential delays and/or changes to the Annual Plan.

People Management

In undertaking audits:

▪ Provide guidance and on the job training for junior colleagues and conduct knowledge sharing to facilitate

achievement of team objectives and completion of tasks in an efficient manner which is consistent with

operating procedures and policy.

▪ Promote the organization’s values and ethics in all activities within the team to support the establishment of a

value driven culture within the bank.

Budgeting and Financial Performance

▪ Monitor the financial performance of given areas of activities versus budgets and ensure all activities are carried

out in line with the approved guidelines while promptly reporting on any variances to management.

Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures

▪ Execute to established GIA Policies, Guidance Notes, Procedures and Practice Notes in undertaking all tasks.

Provide input to the development of GIA practices as per industry standards and regulatory expectations.

▪ Review all the activities of the Units within Information Security, Technology, Data Domain and System

Integration related activities in all the jurisdictions in which the groups operate to define and maintain the Audit

Universe. Coordinate with other teams to ensure efficient and effective coverage.

▪ Prepare and maintain a Risk Assessment of each of the Process Streams within Information Security, Technology,

Data Domain and System Integration related Units and applicable subsidiaries (e.g. international entity) as

identified in the Audit Universe. In this respect, work with the businesses to promote periodic self-assessment of

risks and controls.

▪ Establish/update and maintain Audit programs in the central audit management tool.

▪ Conduct audits of the Processes within Information Security, Technology, Data Domain and System Integration

related activities and assess if:

o Divisional/Unit Line management have identified and classified the risks in their activities.

o Governance, risk management and control procedures are adequate, effective and efficient to reduce risks

of errors, omissions and loss to acceptable levels at an acceptable cost.

o Improvements/enhancements to the governance, risk management and internal control structure are

required.

o Data and transaction processing meet the required standards of reliability, integrity and availability.

o The Division’s/Unit’s assets are being safeguarded.

o The use of resources is efficient and effective.

o Draft audit report submitted by auditors are properly reviewed and finalized.

o Audit report is discussed and finalized with GIA management/client within 6 weeks of completion of

fieldwork. Negotiate with Unit management to agree a documented Management Action Plan to resolve

the issues raised.

Continuous Improvement

▪ Lead the identification of change through continuous improvement of processes and practices considering global

standards and changes in the business environment which demand proactive action plans.

Relationship Management

▪ Develop and maintain effective business relationships with all relevant external/internal entities and stakeholders

with the highest standards of business ethics, whilst promptly attending to all critical issues in-order to ensure

the services required by the organization are delivered in the most effective manner.

▪ Act as the Audit Business Partner for Line Managers within Information Security, Technology, Data Domain and

System Integration Functions and actively manage the relationship through regular meetings with Line Managers

to promote this concept and identify emerging risks. Such meetings should also be used to discuss any material

gaps between audit assessment or risks and controls and the businesses’ self-assessment.

▪ Ongoing consultancy/advice is provided to Unit management from a governance, risk management and control

perspective for improvements in their processes to ensure effective and efficient controls, on the basis of market

best practices.

▪ On an ongoing basis, ensure pending audit issues are followed up with Unit management and that all corrective

actions are fully and properly implemented.

▪ Conduct any investigations/special reviews assigned by Head of Audit/GCAO.

Reporting

Ensure that all functional reports are prepared timely and accurately and meet Group requirements, policies and

quality standards.

Job Context:

Specific Accountability

▪ Safeguarding against potential loss and contributing to the Information Security, Technology, Data Domain and

System Integration systems and procedures, by reporting whether Operational/Regulatory controls of FAB

standards are effectively carried out and are efficient in the units/departments audited.

▪ Reviewing the functions within Information Security, Technology, Data Domain and System Integration of the

bank end to end and identifying areas of correction / improvement.

▪ Lead and guide team members on applying data analytics/automated/enhanced testing techniques in audit

execution, including continuous monitoring routines across domains of Information Security, Technology, Data

Domain and System Integration systems, to extend assurance beyond sample-based testing and to support

continuous auditing of key controls.

Examine and comment on the process for the early recognition of problems (if any) and their remedial

management to minimize the loss.

▪ Preparation / Review of Audit MIS/ dashboards including audit committee presentation slides relating to audit

conducted in the GSO, Technology and Data domains.

▪ Maintain up to date knowledge and understanding of key regulatory developments and banking practices,

including but not limited to Information Security, Cyber Security, Business Continuity and Resilience, Technology,

Data Domain (including Data Privacy) and System Integration, across different jurisdictions relevant to FAB Group;

Interpret those requirements into practical control and evidence expectations, drive necessary changes in Audit

plan & working programs to take into consideration regulatory changes across relevant auditable areas.

▪ Act as a trusted advisor to the Business, Group Security, Group Technology and Data Domain, in the areas of

Information Security, Cyber Security, Business Continuity and Resilience, Technology Governance & Risk

Management, Technology Portfolio Management, Technology Outsourcing, Data Privacy, Data Governance

Applied and Advanced Analytics and related Regulatory Compliance.

▪ Contributing towards the enhancement of relationship between GIA and stakeholders.

▪ Keeping abreast of the local and international economic trends, banking practices and regulatory prescriptions.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:

Minimum Qualification

▪ Bachelor’s degree.

▪ Relevant post-graduate qualification and/or relevant professional qualification and/ or certification desirable.

▪ CISA Certification is essential and any additional relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM & CSX.

Minimum Experience

▪ Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience with an International Bank or Big 4. Internal Audit experience strongly

preferred (but not mandatory). At least 5 years similar positions of progressively increasing managerial

responsibilities in the Bank Operations, Risk Management and/or Audit function.

▪ Expert knowledge of operational activities and processes and associated risks within the Information Security,

Cyber Security, BCM, Technology and Data domains, including the control frameworks and standards commonly

used to design and assess controls in those domains.

▪ Strong working knowledge and demonstrable ability to interpret regulatory expectations across multiple

jurisdictions in the domains of Information security, Technology, BCM and Data Management.

▪ Strong leadership capability and team-oriented with highly developed problem-solving skills.

▪ Self-directed, able to manage multiple tasks and ability to work under pressure.

▪ Excellent analytical skills.

▪ Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a strong ability to comprehend, articulate, and translate

complex technology, cybersecurity, and business concepts for diverse stakeholders.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Digital Investment Solutions
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

To lead the digital transformation of the Bank's investment business by converting investment products, services and client journeys into scalable, end-to-end digital experiences across all client segments while driving business growth, operational efficiency and superior client experience.

• The Executive Director, Digital Investment Solutions) will be responsible for defining and executing the digital investment product strategy across all client segments, ensuring that investment products and services are delivered seamlessly through digital channels while maintaining regulatory, operational and client experience standards.
• The role holder will act as the bridge between Investments, Wealth Management, Business, Technology, Operations, Digital, Risk and Compliance teams to understand existing investment product processes, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and develop a multi-year roadmap for the digitization of investment products and investment journeys.
• The individual will own the end-to-end transformation agenda covering mutual funds, equities, ETFs, fixed income, structured products, derivatives, FX, advisory solutions and other investment offerings, with the objective of enabling clients to discover, onboard, transact, monitor and service investments digitally.
• The role requires a strong combination of product expertise, digital transformation experience, process engineering capability and stakeholder management skills to deliver scalable, client-centric and commercially viable digital investment solutions across the Bank.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own the vision, strategy and execution roadmap for the digital wealth and investment platform, enabling clients to seamlessly discover, invest in, monitor and service investment products through digital channels.
• Lead the end-to-end transformation of investment product journeys by assessing existing processes, identifying operational bottlenecks, and implementing scalable, client-centric digital solutions that improve efficiency, control and client experience.
• Drive the digitalization of the Bank's investment product universe, including mutual funds, equities, ETFs, fixed income, derivatives, structured products, FX solutions, advisory services and other wealth management offerings.
• Act as the business owner for digital investment platforms and capabilities, translating business requirements into executable initiatives and partnering with Technology, Operations, Digital, Risk and Compliance teams to ensure successful delivery.
• Establish target operating models, governance frameworks and product controls that support regulatory compliance, operational resilience and consistent client outcomes across all digital investment journeys.
• Collaborate with product specialists, sales teams, relationship managers and investment teams to ensure digital capabilities accurately reflect product features, suitability requirements and client servicing needs.
• Monitor digital adoption, client engagement, revenue contribution and operational metrics, continuously enhancing platform functionality and user experience to support business growth and client satisfaction.
• Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends and evolving client behaviors, incorporating innovation, automation and artificial intelligence capabilities into the Bank's digital wealth and investment offering.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 12-15 years of experience in Wealth Management, Private Banking, Investments, Digital Product Management or Digital Transformation, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale business transformation initiatives.
• Strong understanding of investment products and wealth management solutions including mutual funds, equities, ETFs, fixed income, structured products, FX, derivatives and advisory solutions.
• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing digital customer journeys, product platforms and operating models within banking, wealth management or investment services environments.
• Proven ability to analyse complex business processes, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and implement technology-enabled solutions that enhance client experience and operational effectiveness.
• Strong knowledge of digital product development methodologies, business requirements gathering, process automation, data analytics and stakeholder management across business and technology functions.
• Excellent leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across front office, operations, technology, risk, compliance and senior management teams.
• Strategic thinker with a strong commercial mindset, capable of balancing business growth objectives, client needs, regulatory requirements and operational considerations when developing digital investment propositions.
• Self-driven professional with a strong execution focus, capable of managing multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously and delivering outcomes in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance or a related field.
• Fluent in English, Arabic and other languages are highly appreciated.

• Digital Transformation
• Investment products and wealth management solutions

• Product platforms
• Operating models

• Digital product development methodologies

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
You will build and lead the team that turns DZ’s data into something the business can actually run on. DZ operates across several verticals and markets: digital goods, ticketing, travel and trading, in Iraq, the UAE and KSA. Each has grown its own reporting, its own metric definitions and its own version of the numbers, so basic questions take days and the answers do not always agree.
You will hire the team, own the data platform end to end, from ingestion through warehouse and modelling to the analytics layer on top, and make trusted data a capability the rest of the org can rely on rather than a queue it waits behind.
What you’ll do: Build and lead the data team: Hire, mentor and grow data and analytics engineers, and set the bar for a function that every other team depends on daily.
Own the technical strategy and architecture for the data platform: Ingestion from operational systems and third parties, warehouse and modelling layer, orchestration, and the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across verticals.
Establish a single source of truth for core business metrics: With definitions agreed with commercial, finance and product, and pipelines that make the numbers reproducible and trusted.
Deliver self-serve analytics: So most questions are answered without a ticket, and the team’s time goes to platform work rather than ad hoc pulls.
Treat data as a product and own its reliability: Freshness SLAs, lineage, testing, and alerting that fires when something breaks upstream rather than when a stakeholder notices.
Partner with security and legal on governance: Access control, retention and the handling of PII (passport and telecom identifiers) across markets with different regulatory expectations.
Build the foundation the next stage depends on: Event tracking standards, the data that data science, personalisation, fraud and experimentation will need.
Partner with product and engineering teams: So instrumentation and data contracts are designed into services rather than bolted on afterwards. What you’ll bring: 8+ years in software or data engineering, with 3+ years leading engineering teams, including hiring and growing engineers.
Direct experience building and operating a production data platform: Batch and streaming ingestion, warehouse modelling, orchestration, and the operational discipline to keep it reliable at scale.
Strong hands-on technical judgment to lead design reviews and make build-vs-buy and cost tradeoffs on warehouse and tooling spend.
Deep SQL and dimensional modelling, and comfortable in a Python, TypeScript, Go, Postgres and AWS environment.
Track record of getting an organisation to agree on metric definitions, not just shipping pipelines. Much of this role is aligning people who currently disagree about what a number means.
Governance instincts: Access, PII and retention should be treated as design inputs rather than an audit exercise.
The judgment to sequence a platform build so that it has to be built without laying a foundation that will need to be torn up in a year. Nice to have: Experience standing up a data function from zero, or consolidating fragmented reporting across business units.
Product analytics experience on e-commerce, marketplaces, payments or fintech.
Experience supporting data science and ML in production: Feature pipelines, model serving or MLOps.
MENA or emerging-market experience, including multi-currency and multi-market reporting. Salt is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

jobs.title: Officer, Digital Onboarding & Commercialization Emiratized Role
jobs.description:
SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION

Work with the Indemnities manager as a team in managing customer exit requests and identify possible ways of retention and apply the retention tools to minimize customer attrition and manage customer expectations and communications efficiently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform primary screening into customer's financial records from a credit and risk prospective and propose solutions while working with customers on obtaining guarantees and documents to support proposals that aim to continue the relationship.
• Prepare and submit to management proposals for cases where EOSB are received identifying possibilities in order to be able to continue with the borrowing relationship without overexposing the bank to risk.
• Proactive retention by working with Credit, Collections, Inward Remittances, Operations, Risk, branches, relationship management and other departments involved to identify the risks and potentials of a relationship in light of customer's new financial stand and attend to customer's requests.
• Assess the financial stand of the customer in light of the employment status after the final settlement from the employer is received and propose solutions and work with customers on obtaining guarantees and documents to support proposals that aim to continue the relationship.
• Carry out the operational accepts of the Indemnities department where EOSB have been received, by handling the batches received and ensuring that the alerts are put on the accounts and, when required the accounts are earmarked appropriately.
• Management of internal and external customer communications, with an overall aim to enhance customer experience and develop solid, strong and professional communication skills.
Represent the Indemnities department in meetings with all customers (internal and external) as and when required.
• Ensure all TATs of the department are met and all assigned work is completed in a timely and accurate manner.
• Follow up with other units of the bank to ensure that the process of EOSB is running smoothly to reduce any delays and avoid complaints.
• Maintain up-to-date MIS tracking all important information pertaining to every case handled, and to analyze MIS and submit weekly / monthly statistical reports that assist in KPI and learning / improvement areas.
• Ensure that all matters where a risk or breeches of the process has been identified is escalated to the management through the proper channels.
• Maintain accurate records for all transactions of the department.
• Keep up to date with information on the market offering for individual customers through research, customer declaration, information received from BIU and other sources in order to be constantly educated on what competitors are offering to various customer segments in order to be able to align our offering and solutions accordingly.
• Ensure accuracy of information shared with customer and ensure that there is no unauthorized divulging of confidential information.
• Ad-hoc duties and administrative duties towards retention.
• Adhere to the Standard Operating Procedures, Policies, Code of Conduct and Service Standards of the bank.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

• Good negotiation skills
• Good understanding of the products, policies and systems.
• Interpersonal skills to efficiency interact with customers and other business units.
• Team working skills.
• Ability to present customer's perspective and ability to perform primary initial screening into customer's financial records.
• Very good understanding of product policies, features and running campaigns.
• Knowledge in Banking Systems.
• Minimum of 2 year of experience in the same role.

jobs.description:
Job Description
About the role:

We're looking for a UX Designer who thrives on understanding people. You're at your best when talking to users, uncovering their needs, and translating those insights into better products. Research isn't just part of your process, it's what drives your decisions.

In this role, you'll lead the research side of our design practice, from planning studies and running usability tests to uncovering insights that directly influence our product direction. You'll also help shape how AI can enhance research by making it faster, more scalable, and more effective, while ensuring that human judgment remains at the center of every decision.

Key Responsibilities:

What you'll do

• Lead user research activities, including interviews, contextual inquiries, field studies, and usability testing (moderated and unmoderated).
• Design and execute research plans that answer real product questions, from participant recruitment and study design to scripts, tasks, and analysis.
• Turn qualitative and quantitative findings into clear insights, customer journeys, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
• Validate concepts, designs, and prototypes early and frequently, then measure success through post-release research.
• Leverage AI throughout the research process, including transcription, tagging, clustering, synthesis, interview preparation, and test design, while critically evaluating outputs and safeguarding participant privacy.
• Build and maintain a scalable research practice through templates, research repositories, standards, and shared ways of working.
• Collaborate closely with product owners, developers, and designers in an agile environment, ensuring the voice of the user is represented in product decisions, refinements, and roadmap discussions.
• Advocate for evidence-based decision making and help foster a culture of continuous learning and user-centered design.

Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience in UX Research, or UX Design with a strong research focus.
• A bachelor’s in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), User Experience Design, Interaction Design, Design Research, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
• Strong expertise across a variety of research methods and the ability to choose the right approach for the problem at hand.

The ideal candidate has strong Linux administration experience, deep knowledge of HPC schedulers, and hands-on familiarity with engineering simulation tools.

A. Infrastructure Management

• Manage and maintain HPC-related databases, ensuring timely backups and audit compliance.
• Monitor hardware health including CPU temperatures, memory errors, and disk failures.

B. Scheduler & Resource Management

• Implement and maintain fair-share scheduling, job priority rules, QoS limits, and preemption policies.
• Manage node reservations for large-scale CFD/FEA workloads.
• Provide best-practice recommendations for CPU/GPU architecture selection for engineering simulations.
• Prevent resource misuse, including node hogging, queue congestion, and starvation of small jobs.
C. User Access, Security & Compliance
• Manage user accounts, permissions, and storage quotas.
• Enforce secure SSH access, MFA, and other security controls.
• Ensure compliance with IT governance, data-security, and audit requirements.
• Apply OS patches, security updates, and vulnerability fixes.

RESTRICTED

• Conduct performance tuning and benchmarking for CFD/FEA workloads.
• Recommend improvements to enhance throughput and efficiency.

• Provide training sessions and best-practice guidance for HPC users.
• Maintain documentation, onboarding guides, and knowledge-base resources.

• Manage backup, archival systems, and RAID configurations.
• Ensure smooth operation of parallel file systems (Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS).
• Support efficient data workflows for large CFD/FEA datasets.

• Provide input into long-term HPC strategy and infrastructure roadmap.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• 3–7 years of experience administering Linux-based HPC clusters.
• Strong knowledge of HPC schedulers (Slurm/PBS/LSF).

• Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python).
• Experience with high-speed networking and parallel file systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of container technologies (Singularity/Apptainer).

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Software (C4 / HMI) - Defence
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking experienced Software Engineers with a focus on User Interface design (HFI/UI/UX) to support development of a complex Defence Communications and Command & Control (C2) system. The successful candidates will contribute to the design, development, integration, and maintenance of software components underpinning mission-critical communications and operational capabilities, working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment alongside systems engineers, software architects, integration engineers, test teams, and operational stakeholders. The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, a disciplined approach to design and testing, and experience developing distributed or communications-based applications in Java.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Produce UI product/system requirement specifications based on end-user input and operational analysis, translating user needs to relevant functional engineering teams

• Develop product/system design concepts and implementation specifications with a focus on usability

• Create, evaluate, and modify prototypes, operational scenarios, and process maps - with emphasis on operational context, interaction, physical manipulation, and task analysis

• Contribute to software architecture, detailed design, and software integration activities across complex distributed systems

• Produce and maintain software design artefacts/models; participate in technical reviews and design discussions

• Ensure software quality through disciplined development and verification: automated unit tests, integration/system/acceptance testing support, and code/peer reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Degree in Software Engineering

• Minimum 8 years' experience in software development, preferably within communications, defence, mission-critical, or distributed systems

• Strong proficiency in Java development

• Experience analysing designs/requirements from a Human Factors / Human Systems Integration perspective, including Task Analyses (Mission Task Analysis, Top-Down Functional Analysis, Critical Task Analysis)

• Experience with GIS frameworks (e.g., LuciadLightspeed, NASA World Wind) and proficiency with Web UI fundamentals (HTML, JavaScript, CSS)

• Solid understanding of UML/software modelling and core software engineering principles (modular design, high cohesion/low coupling, object-oriented design)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Experience developing communications systems or network-enabled applications

• Familiarity with messaging protocols and distributed messaging architectures

• Experience developing real-time or near-real-time systems, and/or with GIS

• Familiarity with software development in defence, security, or safety-critical environments

• Experience with automated build/CI pipelines

• Experience supporting software integration and verification activities within larger system developments

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

Responsibilities

Key Skills

• Strong understanding of systems engineering processes and lifecycle management.

jobs.title: Senior Payload Data Operator
jobs.description:
External Job Description


FADA is seeking a Senior Payload Data Processing Engineer to design, develop, and operate processing chains that transform raw satellite payload data into calibrated, analysis-ready products. The role covers the full downstream processing chain, from Level-0 ingestion through Level-1 and Level-2 products.
The successful candidate will have hands-on experience with both Electro-Optical (EO) and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) payloads and will work closely with satellite operations teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Define EO product specifications with end users, mission engineers, and stakeholders to meet mission objectives.
• Translate user and mission requirements into processing specifications, product formats, and metadata standards.
• Act as the technical interface between payload processing, satellite operations, and system engineering teams.
• Design, develop, and maintain processing pipelines from raw data ingestion through Level-0, Level-1, and Level-2 products.
• Implement optical image processing algorithms, including registration, georeferencing, orthorectification, radiometric and atmospheric correction, cloud masking, classification, and derived products.
• Integrate workflows into scalable, automated processing systems with defined throughput and latency targets.
• Support multi-payload and multi-sensor operations across different platforms and data sources.
• Continuously improve processing chains through the evaluation of new algorithms, tools, and techniques.
• Contribute to payload characterization, calibration, and validation (Cal/Val) activities.
• Collaborate with satellite operations teams to improve product quality throughout the acquisition-to-delivery cycle.
• Lead investigations into data chain anomalies and drive issues to resolution across payload, downlink, ingestion, and processing stages.
• Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and represent FADA in engagements with suppliers, vendors, and partners.
Education & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Remote Sensing, Geomatics, Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.
Must have skills
• 5-8 years of experience in satellite payload data processing, with responsibility for processing chains, algorithms, or product lines.
• Hands-on experience processing optical EO data, including calibration, correction, and product generation.
• Hands-on experience processing SAR data, including focusing raw data into Level-1 image products.
• Experience developing, validating, commissioning, and operating payload data processing systems.
Desired Skills
• Strong knowledge of remote sensing principles and optical and radar image processing.
• Familiarity with geospatial data structures, coordinate systems, projections, and standards such as GeoTIFF, STAC, and OGC services.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent technical communication, and the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary operational environments

jobs.title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
jobs.summary: At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge?
jobs.description:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date.

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking

- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components

- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.

- An interest in computer sciences and information technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Data Scientist

The Big Picture

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco employs over 75,000 associates, has 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide and over 14,000 IoT-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations. For fiscal year 2025 that ended June 29, 2025, the company generated sales of more than $81.4 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

The Opportunity

We are currently on the lookout for Data Scientists to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Extract, transform, and analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets using Python, SQL, and cloud-based technologies.
• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model development to address business challenges.
• Develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy machine learning models, including predictive, classification, and forecasting solutions.
• Build and maintain scalable data and machine learning pipelines for production environments.
• Develop AI-powered solutions using Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, and Agentic AI concepts.
• Monitor model performance, conduct model validation, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to ensure accuracy and reliability.
• Apply statistical analysis and experimentation techniques to identify insights and support data-driven decision-making.
• Translate analytical findings and model outputs into actionable business recommendations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Data Engineers, and other cross functional teams to deliver impactful solutions.
• Document data science methodologies, model assumptions, and technical approaches to support knowledge sharing and governance.
• Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and code quality standards.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
• Hands-on experience with data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, or similar.
• Solid understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation methodologies.
• Experience working with time-series forecasting, predictive analytics, classification models, and imbalanced datasets.
• Familiarity with data processing frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.
• Understanding of MLOps concepts, CI/CD pipelines, Git, APIs, and model deployment practices.
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Knowledge of Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and AI agents.

Benefits

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Paid birthday leave Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

• Hybrid work arrangement

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.summary: You will be a Prototyping Engagement Manager in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and Customer Engineering) team, based in Riyadh. You are the face of PACE for customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia — helping
jobs.description:
You will be a Prototyping Engagement Manager in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and Customer Engineering) team, based in Riyadh. You are the face of PACE for customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia — helping enterprises turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS.

You work at the intersection of business strategy and emerging technology. You identify the opportunities where generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud-native architectures can create the most value for a customer — then you shape, qualify, and drive those engagements from first conversation to working prototype and beyond.

You pilot a pipeline of high-value innovation opportunities, you earn the trust of C-suite and technical leaders alike, and you create the conditions for brilliant engineers to do their best work. You pair with hands-on Prototyping Architects to deliver multi-week hands-on engagements that de-risk transformation, prove out new workloads, and accelerate customers' paths to production.

You thrive in ambiguity. Your customers are navigating generational technology shifts — foundation models, autonomous agents, intelligent automation — and you help them cut through the noise, make crisp decisions, and move fast. You work backwards from customer outcomes, you insist on the highest standards in scoping and delivery, and you invent on behalf of customers who don't yet know what's possible.

This role is based in Riyadh and supports customers across KSA and the wider GCC, working alongside account teams, specialist organisations, and partners to drive workload adoption at the frontier of what AWS can do.

Key job responsibilities

You build and pilot a pipeline of innovation opportunities across KSA and the GCC — working with account teams, specialists, and partners to proactively identify where generative AI and cloud-native architecture can unlock the most value.

You qualify with rigour. You ask the hard questions early — is there a real business outcome, a committed customer, a path to production? You invest resources where they matter and disqualify where they don't.

You scope engagements that set teams up for success — working backwards from customer outcomes to define crisp, time-boxed prototypes with clear success criteria.

You drive engagements from kickoff to close — coordinating customer developers, AWS architects, and partners, mitigating risk, and ensuring every engagement closes with demonstrated value and a concrete next step.

You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders — helping executives navigate generational technology shifts and make confident investment decisions.

You scale what works — packaging repeatable motions and sharing them across the PACE community worldwide.

You represent the customer internally — feeding engagement insights back into AWS service teams and product roadmaps.

A day in the life

You start with a standup — a customer's engineering team is two weeks into a generative AI prototype and needs your help unblocking a decision. Mid-morning, you're scoping a new engagement with a Saudi enterprise exploring agentic AI. After lunch you review your pipeline, update qualifications, and plan resourcing with your Prototyping Architect. Later, you're with a customer's CTO — they've seen prototype results and want to talk path to production. You finish the day writing up a repeatable pattern you spotted, something the wider PACE team could use.

About the team

PACE (Prototyping AI and Customer Engineering) is AWS's hands-on customer innovation team. We work directly with enterprise customers to turn their boldest ideas into working technology — building prototypes that de-risk transformation and accelerate adoption.

Our model pairs Engagement Managers with Prototyping Architects: you shape the opportunity, they shape the technology, and together you deliver something real. This role sits within EMEA PACE, supporting customers across KSA and the wider GCC, backed by a worldwide community that shares patterns, tools, and lessons learned.

Basic qualifications
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 2+ years of software development experience

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications
- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion

AWS is looking for Data Center Engineers/Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases.

You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions.

Key job responsibilities

SAFETY

- Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster a strong safety culture.

DATA CENTER OPERATIONS (DCO)

This position involves:

- Diagnosing hardware and network problems followed by physical repairs

- Troubleshooting events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Performing root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with regulations)

About the team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

- Experience in computer networking, or experience working with Linux operating systems

- Computer networking experience, or experience working with Linux operating systems

- Computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles

- Saudi National only

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working to appropriate health & safety standards and regulations

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager

- Knowledge of cabling best practices

- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Hardlines Category, 3rd Party Marketplace (Saudi National)
jobs.summary: The Amazon Saudi Arabia Marketplace team is seeking a talented, customer-obsessed Category Merchant Manager (CMM) to help shape the future of our Home and Electronics marketplace. This role offers a unique
jobs.description:
The Amazon Saudi Arabia Marketplace team is seeking a talented, customer-obsessed Category Merchant Manager (CMM) to help shape the future of our Home and Electronics marketplace. This role offers a unique opportunity to own substantial portions of our rapidly expanding Home and Electronics category P&Ls while driving large-scale, high-visibility strategic projects across multiple teams.

In this position, you'll take ownership of significant portions of our fast-growing Home and Electronics category P&Ls, driving both top-line growth and bottom-line efficiency. But your impact will extend far beyond the numbers. You'll be the architect of strategic initiatives that redefine how third-party sellers engage with our Home and Electronics marketplace, crafting incentive frameworks that align seller success with customer satisfaction. Your influence will span across the organization, from collaborating with our Quality Assurance team to ensure the highest standards for electronics and home goods, to partnering with our Supply Chain experts to optimize the complex logistics of large home items and delicate electronics.

The ideal candidate for this role brings a wealth of retail experience in Home and Electronics, coupled with a forward-thinking approach to digital commerce. You'll leverage your deep understanding of both categories to curate an unparalleled selection for our customers in Saudi Arabia. Your analytical prowess will be put to the test as you dive deep into data, unearthing insights that inform category growth strategies and drive decision-making at the highest levels of the organization. Most importantly, you'll be a collaborative leader, adept at navigating cross-functional partnerships and influencing senior stakeholders across Amazon's vast ecosystem.

This is more than just a job – it's an opportunity to shape the future of Home and Electronics retail in the digital age within the Saudi Arabian market. You'll be at the intersection of technology, consumer behavior, and cultural preferences, developing expertise that spans from supply chain optimization to advanced analytics. If you're ready to bring your passion for Home and Electronics and your hunger for innovation to one of the world's most customer-centric companies, we want to hear from you. Join us in Saudi Arabia as we revolutionize the way the Kingdom shops for home goods and electronics.

Key job responsibilities

CATEGORY STRATEGIC PLANNING

- Collaborate closely with Home and Electronics Leadership on planning and business strategy

- Drive a best-in-class shopping experience for customers in Home and Electronics categories

- Maximize unit sales and Gross Merchandise Sales (GMS) growth through timely analysis and action

- Optimize assortments across various home goods and electronics product lines

- Develop strategies to enhance seasonal offerings and stay ahead of technological trends

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

- Partner with Marketplace teams to identify and recruit strategic sellers in Home and Electronics

- Focus on expanding category group selection offerings

- Develop frameworks to onboard and support small to mid-size brands in both categories

- Create incentive structures to attract top-tier national and international brands to the platform

CX AND SX IMPROVEMENT

- Innovate with our sellers to drive optimal customer experience across the Home and Electronics 3P business

- Deploy the Amazon vision for Home and Electronics on the 3P side, ensuring seamless integration with 1P offerings

- Ensure customer experience parity between 1P and 3P items in both categories

- Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to maintain highest standards for electronics and home goods

- Work with Supply Chain to optimize delivery experience for large home items and delicate electronics

A day in the life

As HL CMM, you'll drive strategic decision-making through data-driven insights and market analysis. Your day involves monitoring category performance metrics, collaborating with sellers to optimize their offerings, and working with cross-functional teams to enhance the customer shopping experience. Key activities include reviewing daily sales performance, conducting seller business reviews, participating in supply chain optimization meetings, and developing strategies to expand product lines and stay ahead of technological trends. You'll focus on maintaining high-quality standards for home goods and ensuring that electronics offerings meet the latest industry specifications and consumer demands.

Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

- Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network

- 4+ years of working cross functionally with non-tech teams experience

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development

- Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems

Preferred qualifications
- Master of Business Administration, or Associate's degree or above

- Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

- Experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems, or experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing large, complicated programs

- Experience with P&L responsibility and delivering strong financial results

jobs.title: Security Assurance Specialist, UAE, AWS Compliance and Security Assurance
jobs.summary: Amazon obsesses over customers, and delivering secure cloud solutions for customers is our priority. We are looking for a cybersecurity professional with security assurance and compliance experience to
jobs.description:
Amazon obsesses over customers, and delivering secure cloud solutions for customers is our priority. We are looking for a cybersecurity professional with security assurance and compliance experience to support AWS's cybersecurity initiatives in the UAE region.

In this role, the successful candidate will enjoy working across many stakeholders, including internal and external customers, to design solutions for complex compliance challenges. You are passionate about the security of the cloud and you want to solve real business problems.

We have a team culture that encourages ownership, diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We expect team members and management alike to take a high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. We expect this person to balance their unique perspective with those of the diverse perspectives of the team and its stakeholders. You will have an opportunity to work directly with senior leadership within Amazon to improve our ability to demonstrate assurance for regulated customers.

You should be a technically experienced and innovative security, compliance, and audit professional who has the ability to understand IT processes, communicate clearly and transparently with customers, and to be able to drive innovative process changes through multiple organizations and teams.

**You should be UAE National to be considered for this role.**

Key job responsibilities

As part of the team, you will work with customers and regulators to demonstrate Amazon security controls applicable to local requirements. You will join our team in helping customers understand how our infrastructure is designed, operated, maintained, and protected in accordance with global regulated industry standards.

In this role, you will be responsible for the following activities:

- Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to articulate compliance implications to both customers and internal/external audit functions.

- Develop understanding of regulated industry compliance requirements and communicate how we control activities to meet global regulatory obligations.

- Liaise with customers, regulators and auditors, articulate control implementation, and describe considerations for applying security and compliance concepts to monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the organization by being a trusted advisor, facilitator and creative problem solver.

- Implement continuous improvements to the security organization and the program management process. Share program/project process frameworks, tools, and best practices that can be adopted throughout the organization.

Apply a working knowledge of global information security regulation and policy to articulate customer and control impact and drive alignment to Amazon controls.

A day in the life

On any given day, you'll be working directly with customers to respond to their assurance needs, helping third-party auditors understand the AWS control environment, or talking to regulators about how AWS views cloud security. You'll be talking to AWS service teams about how the technology works under the hood and helping translate that technology into meaningful security and compliance outcomes.

About the team

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance

Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience

- 5+ years of working experience in performing and/or participating in IT audits and assessments of highly technical cloud-based environments.

- 5+ years working in highly regulated industries (e.g. financial services, healthcare, and energy, telecommunications).

- Business level proficiency in English (verbal and written) and Arabic (verbal)

Preferred qualifications
- 5+ years of one or more of the following: big data, DevOps, security, systems administration, software development, cloud technology experience

- 1 or more industry-recognized security, cloud, or audit professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CISSP, CCSP, Amazon Cloud Practitioner

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs

Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery

Engaging with AWS customers and internal stakeholders as trusted security advisors to executives and technical teams

Promoting Amazon's culture of security and maintain the highest security standards throughout your interactions with customers, partners, peers and internal stakeholders.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Data Scientist

The Big Picture

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco employs over 75,000 associates, has 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide and over 14,000 IoT-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations. For fiscal year 2025 that ended June 29, 2025, the company generated sales of more than $81.4 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

The Opportunity

We are currently on the lookout for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Work on end-to-end Data Science and Machine Learning projects, from problem definition and data exploration to model development, deployment, and performance monitoring.
• Translate complex business problems into scalable analytical, machine learning, and AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
• Design and develop advanced machine learning models, including forecasting, predictive analytics, classification, recommendation systems, anomaly detection, and deep learning solutions.
• Development and deployment of Generative AI applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, Agentic AI frameworks, NLP techniques, and workflow orchestration tools.
• Own model lifecycle management, including training, deployment, monitoring, explainability, validation, governance, and performance optimization.
• Design and implement scalable cloud-based data science and AI solutions across AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent platforms.
• Perform advanced statistical analysis, experimentation, feature engineering, forecasting, and root-cause analysis to enhance model accuracy and business outcomes.
• Develop and maintain high-quality, reusable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices.
• Technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex data, model, and pipeline issues in production environments.
• Establish and promote best practices in data science, machine learning engineering, MLOps, and AI governance.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and leadership to define roadmaps and technical strategies.
• Mentor junior Data Scientists and contribute to knowledge sharing, onboarding, code reviews, and technical leadership within the team.
• Communicate technical concepts, insights, risks, assumptions, and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• 2-4 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related analytical disciplines.
• Advanced expertise in Python and strong proficiency in SQL. • Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Statistical Modelling, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, and Model Evaluation techniques.
• Experience building and deploying production-scale machine learning solutions.
• Expertise in forecasting, time-series modelling, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and advanced analytics techniques.
• Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Prophet, DeepAR, or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, governance, and automation.
• Experience with workflow orchestration and data engineering tools such as Airflow, Spark, PySpark, and ETL/ELT frameworks.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including cloud-native ML and data services.
• Strong knowledge of Generative AI technologies

Benefits

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Paid birthday leave Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

• Hybrid work arrangement

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The position offers a unique opportunity to combine finance knowledge, system expertise, problem-solving skills, and project involvement in a global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Systems Support

• Provide functional support for finance applications, including IFS Cloud Finance modules.
• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system incidents, service requests, and user queries.
• Manage support tickets in accordance with agreed service levels and priorities.
• Collaborate with technical teams and vendors to resolve complex issues.
• Monitor recurring issues and identify opportunities for permanent corrective actions.
• Ensure timely communication with stakeholders on incident progress and resolution.

Business Process & Continuous Improvement

• Partner with Finance teams to understand business requirements and challenges.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and user experience through system enhancements.
• Document business requirements and participate in solution design activities.
• Support process standardization and automation initiatives across Finance functions.

System Administration & Governance

• Assist with setup and administration of:

• Companies and legal entities

• Cost centers and organizational hierarchies

• User access and security permissions
• Approval workflows and authority structures

Project & Change Delivery

Reporting & Data Quality
